834.e: Without an encounter with you, I will burn in the fire of separation.(22)

834.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
834.e: Dohira

834.g: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਲ ਕੇ; ਅਤਿਥ ਭੇਸ ਕੋ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
834.e: The woman weared the new clothes and put the expensive garments.

834.g: ਤਵਨ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਭਿਤ ਕਰੀ; ਉਤਮ ਭੇਖ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
834.e: And in new form she adorned the decorated bed.(12)

834.g: ਤਬ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਯੌ ਕਹੀ; ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
834.e: Then the lady asked him, ‘Please have intercourse with me,

834.g: ਪਸੁ ਪਤਾਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਦੈ ਘਨੋ; ਮੈ ਬੇਚੀ ਤਵ ਹਾਥ ॥੧੩॥
834.e: ‘Because, tormented by Cupid, I am handing over myself to you.’(I3)

834.g: ਰਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੀ; ਬੈਠੇ ਤਾਹੀ ਠੌਰ ॥
834.e: The monarch said ‘I had come to learn incantation,

834.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਲੈਨ ਆਯੋ ਹੁਤੋ; ਭਈ ਔਰ ਕੀ ਔਰ ॥੧੪॥
834.e: But the situation is quite contrary (I4)

835.g: ਛੰਦ ॥
835.e: Chhand

835.g: ਤਰੁਨ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋਹਿ; ਤਰੁਨਿ ਹੀ ਦੇਹ ਹਮਾਰੋ ॥
835.e: (She) ‘You have been bestowed with youth and I am young too.

835.g: ਲਖੇ ਤੁਮੈ ਤਨ ਆਜੁ; ਮਦਨ ਬਸਿ ਭਯੋ ਹਮਾਰੋ ॥
835.e: ‘Seeing you I have overcome with passion.

835.g: ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ; ਭੋਗ ਮੋਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥
835.e: ‘Abandon all your misconceptions and relish sex with me,

835.g: ਨਰਕ ਪਰਨ ਤੇ ਨੈਕ; ਅਪਨ ਚਿਤ ਬੀਚ ਨ ਡਰਿਯੈ ॥੩੭॥
835.e: ‘And don’t worry about the fear of the hell.’(37)

835.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
835.e: Dohira

835.g: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੌ, ਕੈਸੇ ਬਚੌ, ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਸਾਤ ॥
835.e: (She, thinking,) ‘What should 1 do to save myself so that my mind is appeased?

835.g: ਤੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਿਯੋ, ਬਚਨ ਨੇਹ ਕੇ ਨਾਤ ॥੪੦॥
835.e: ‘Your utterances depict love, how could I kill you.( 40)

835.g: ਰਾਇ ਬਾਚ ॥
835.e: Raja spoke, ‘First of all God has endowed me birth as a Kashatri,

835.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਛਤ੍ਰਿ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ; ਦਿਯੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਨਮ ਹਮਾਰੋ ॥
ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਕੇ ਬੀਚ; ਕਿਯੋ ਕੁਲ ਅਧਿਕ ਉਜਿਯਾਰੋ ॥
835.e: Our dynasty is very much respected in the world.

835.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਭਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਠਿ; ਆਪੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਹਾਊ ॥
835.e: Being seated (as Raja) I am worshipped.

835.g: ਹੋ ਰਮੋ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ਸਾਥ; ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਪਾਊ ॥੩੨॥
835.e: ‘But, now, if I ravish with you, I will be reborn in a low caste.’(32)

835.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ, ਜਨਮ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਰਮੋ ਨ ਹਮ ਸੋ ਆਜੁ; ਐਸ ਘਟਿ ਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
835.e: (She said,) ‘What are you talking about the birth? They are your concoction..

835.g: ਬਿਰਹ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਲਾਲ, ਬੈਠਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਮੋ ਬਰਿਯੈ ॥
835.e: ‘If you don’t cherish me, then It will be my bad luck.

835.g: ਹੋ ਪੀਵ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਆਜੁ; ਮਿਲੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿਯੈ ॥੩੩॥
835.e: ‘Without meeting you, I will poison myself.’(33)

835.g: ਟਾਗ ਤਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ; ਕੇਲ ਕੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
835.e: (Raja,) ‘Only that one crawls through the legs who is unable to indulge in sex,

835.g: ਬੈਠਿ ਨਿਫੂੰਸਕ ਰਹੈ; ਰੈਨਿ ਸਿਗਰੀ ਨ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
835.e: And remains sitting whole night like a eunuch and does not perform.

835.g: ਬਧੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੈ; ਨ ਭੋਗ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਥ ਕਰਤ ਹੋ ॥
835.e: ‘Being prevailed by the righteousness I will not copulate with you.

835.g: ਜਗ ਅਪਜਸ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ; ਅਧਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਬੀਚ ਡਰਤ ਹੋ ॥੨੯॥
835.e: ‘I am always fearful of the criticism of the public.(29)

835.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਤੁਮ ਕਰੋ; ਭਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੋਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਰੋ ॥
835.e: (She,) ‘Do whatever you may, but I will never leave you without sex.

835.g: ਗਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਰ ਆਜੁ; ਸਗਰ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਨਿਸ ਭੋਰੋ ॥
835.e: ‘With my own hands 1 will tear you off,

835.g: ਮੀਤ, ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਹੇਤ; ਕਾਸਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਹੂੰ ਲੈਹੋ ॥
835.e: And, then, get myself sawn through at Kanshi and, would even face

835.g: ਹੋ ਧਰਮਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਸਭਾ; ਜ੍ਵਾਬ ਠਾਢੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਦੈਹੋ ॥੩੦॥
835.e: The Lord of Righteousness in his court.(30)

835.g: ਆਜੁ ਪਿਯਾ, ਤਵ ਸੰਗ; ਸੇਜੁ ਰੁਚਿ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਹੈਹੋ ॥
835.e: ‘Oh my love, I have sworn to bed with you, and

835.g: ਮਨ ਭਾਵਤ ਕੋ ਭੋਗ; ਰੁਚਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਕਮੈਹੋ ॥
835.e: ‘Fully satisfy myself carnally.

835.g: ਆਜੁ ਸੁ ਰਤਿ ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ; ਭੋਗ ਸੁੰਦਰ, ਤਵ ਕਰਿਹੋ ॥
835.e: ‘Tonight, through sex I will make you look more handsome,

835.g: ਸਿਵ ਬੈਰੀ ਕੋ ਦਰਪ ਸਕਲ; ਮਿਲਿ ਤੁਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਰਿਹੋ ॥੩੧॥
835.e: And will make Cupid to lose his pride too.’(31)

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ. ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
835.e: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ; ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
835.e: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

835.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
835.e: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

835.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ. ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
835.e: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

835.g: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
835.e: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
835.e: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

835.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
835.e: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

835.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
835.e: Chaupaee

835.g: ਰਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
ਇਹਾ ਸਿਖ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਹਮਾਰੋ ॥
835.e: :By living her my righteousness is destroyed,

835.g: ਯਾਹਿ ਭਜੇ ਮੇਰੋ ਧ੍ਰਮ ਜਾਈ ॥
ਛੰਦ ॥
835.e: Chhand

835.g: ਕਹਾ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਨੇਹ ਨਹਿ ਓਰ ਨਿਬਾਹਹਿ ॥
835.e: What to talk of love with the women, as they never fulfil,

835.g: ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੌ ਛਾਡਿ; ਔਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਰ ਚਾਹਹਿ ॥
835.e: They desert one man and go after another who is better looking.

835.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਰੁਚਿ ਮਾਨਿ; ਤਰੁਨਿ ਜਾ ਸੋ ਹਿਤ ਕਰਹੀ ॥
835.e: For whosoever she makes mind for, she becomes naked before him,

835.g: ਹੋ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਧਾਮ; ਨਗਨ ਆਗੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਹੀ ॥੩੯॥
835.e: And immediately presents him her unclad urinary place.(39)

835.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
835.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

835.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ. ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
835.e: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

835.g: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
835.e: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

835.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
835.e: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

835.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ; ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
835.e: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

835.g: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ. ਭਇਆ ਬਨ. ਵਾਸੀ; ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
835.e: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

835.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
835.e: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

835.g: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ; ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.e: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

835.g: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ. ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
835.e: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

835.g: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ. ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ; ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.e: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

835.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ. ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ, ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ, ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
835.e: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

835.g: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
835.e: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

835.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
835.e: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

835.g: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ; ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
835.e: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

835.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ; ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
835.e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

835.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ; ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
835.e: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

835.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ. ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
835.e: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

835.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.e: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

835.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
835.e: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

835.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
835.e: Dohira

835.g: ਪੂਜ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰ ਜੋ ਤਰੁਨਿ; ਮੁਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਤ ਪਯਾਨ ॥
835.e: ‘The lady who comes to me to worship me,

835.g: ਤਵਨਿ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਵਨ ਕੀ; ਲਾਗਤ ਸੁਤਾ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੩੮॥
835.e: ‘To me, she is like the daughter of my Guru.’(38)

835.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
835.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

835.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ. ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
835.e: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.

835.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
835.e: Dohira

835.g: ਰਾਇ ਡਰਿਯੋ ਜਉ ਦੈ ਮੁਝੈ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਤਿ ਕੀ ਆਨ ॥
835.e: The Raja was worried, if she imposed the oath of Bhagauti, the Goddess,

835.g: ਸੰਕ ਤ︀ਯਾਗ ਯਾ ਸੋ ਰਮੋ ਕਰਿਹੌ ਨਰਕ ਪਯਾਨ ॥੩੪॥
835.e: Be will have to ravish her and, then, go to hell.(34)

835.g: ਚਿਤ ਕੇ ਸੋਕ ਨਿਵਰਤ ਕਰਿ; ਰਮੋ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸੰਗ ॥
835.e: (She) ‘Get rid of all your doubts, savour me,

835.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਬ︀ਯਾਪਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨੰਗ ॥੩੫॥
835.e: ‘Because Cupid is over powering me.’(35)

835.g: ਨਰਕ ਪਰਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਡਰੋ; ਕਰੋ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਸੰਗ ॥
835.e: (Be) ‘How-so-ever Cupid may overwhelm, due to the dread of hell,

835.g: ਤੋ ਤਨ ਮੋ ਤਨ ਕੈਸਊ ਬ︀ਯਾਪਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਨੰਗ ॥੩੬॥
835.e: I will never indulge with you.’(36)

836.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
836.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

836.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
836.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

836.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ; ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
836.e: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

836.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
836.e: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.

836.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਮੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
836.e: The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||

836.g: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ; ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ. ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
836.e: Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains of separation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

836.g: ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ; ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
836.e: The doctors and healers look at me, and are perplexed. Within my heart, mind and body, I feel the pain of divine love. ||2||

836.g: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ. ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
836.e: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without my Beloved, like the opium addict who cannot live without opium.

836.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ, ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
836.e: Those who thirst for God, do not love any other. Without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||3||

836.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
836.e: If only someone would come and unite me with God; I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to him.

836.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ. ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ; ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
836.e: After being separated from the Lord for countless incarnations, I am re-united with Him, entering the Sanctuary of the True, True, True Guru. ||4||

836.g: ਛੰਦ ॥
836.e: Chhand

836.g: ਸੁਧਿ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਧਰੀ; ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਦਏ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
836.e: (Raja) ‘Since the time I realized the sense of maturity, which my Guru had taught,

836.g: ਪੂਤ, ਇਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਨ ਤੋਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਘਟ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
836.e: “Aye My Son, so long as there is life m your body,

836.g: ਨਿਜ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ; ਨੇਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈਯਹੁ ॥
836.e: “You promise to enhance love with your own wife,

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ; ਭੂਲਿ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਜੈਯਹੁ ॥੫੧॥
836.e: “But never, even by mistake, bed with else’s wife.(51)

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਭਜੇ; ਸਹਸ ਬਾਸਵ ਭਗ ਪਾਏ ॥
836.e: “By relishing else’s wife, Inder, the god was showered with female genitals.

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਭਜੇ; ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਾਲੰਕ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
836.e: “By relishing else’s wife, Moon was blemished.

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ; ਸੀਸ ਦਸ ਸੀਸ ਗਵਾਯੋ ॥
836.e: “By relishing else’s wife, Ten Headed Raawana lost all his ten heads.

836.g: ਹੋ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ; ਕਟਕ ਕਵਰਨ ਕੌ ਘਾਯੋ ॥੫੨॥
836.e: “By relishing else’s wife all the clan of Korav was annihilated.(52)

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੌ ਨੇਹੁ; ਛੁਰੀ ਪੈਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ॥
836.e: “The love with else’s wife is like a sharp dagger.

836.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਭਜੇ ਕਾਲ ਬ︀ਯਾਪਯੋ ਤਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ॥
836.e: “The love with else’s wife is an invitation to death.

836.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਹਰੀਫੀ ਜਾਨਿ; ਭੋਗ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਜੋ ਕਰਹੀ ॥
836.e: “The one who thinks himself to be very brave and indulges carnally with else’s wife,

836.g: ਹੋ ਅੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਕੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਹਾਥ ਲੇਾਂਡੀ ਕੇ ਮਰਹੀ ॥੫੩॥
836.e: “He is killed in the hands of a coward like a dog.”(53)

836.g: ਬਾਲ, ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪਾਸ; ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
836.e: “Listen lady! Women come to us from far off lands,

836.g: ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤ ਬਰ ਮਾਗਿ; ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ, ਸੀਸ ਝੁਕਾਵਹਿ ॥
836.e: “They bow their heads and wish for boons.

836.g: ਸਿਖ︀ਯ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਾਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਿਤ ਧਰਿਯੈ ॥
836.e: “Those Sikhs (disciples) are like my sons and their wives like my daughters.

836.g: ਹੋ ਕਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ, ਤਿਹ ਸਾਥ; ਗਵਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥੫੪॥
836.e: “Tell me, now, the pretty one, how could I copulate with them.”(54)

836.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
836.e: Dohira

836.g: ਬਹੁਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ; ਯੌ ਬਚ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
836.e: Then she declared loudly and told, the Raja.

836.g: ਆਜ ਭੋਗ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਕਰੌ; ਕੈ ਮਰਿਹੌ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੪੬॥
836.e: ‘Either I will have sex with you or I will kill myself by taking poison.’(46)

836.g: ਬਿਸਿਖੀ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਤਵ; ਬਿਧਨਾ ਧਰੇ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
836.e: (Raja,) ‘God has created your eyes like sharp arrows,

836.g: ਲਾਜ ਕੌਚ ਮੋ ਕੌ ਦਯੋ; ਚੁਭਤ ਨ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਇ ॥੪੭॥
836.e: ‘But He has endowed me modesty and that is why they cannot pierce me.(47)

836.g: ਬਨੇ ਠਨੇ ਆਵਤ ਘਨੇ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਰਤ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ॥
836.e: ‘Your eyes are penetrating and on the very first sight they oust the knowledge.

836.g: ਭੋਗ ਕਰਨ ਕੌ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਡਹਕੂ ਬੇਰ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੪੮॥
836.e: ‘But for me, having no attraction for sex, they are merely like berries.’(48)

836.g: ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਬੇਰ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਪਥਿਕ ਕੌ ਲੇਤ ॥
836.e: (She) ‘Worthy are those berries whom whole world can see,

836.g: ਬਰਬਸ ਖੁਆਵਤ ਫਲ ਪਕਰਿ; ਜਾਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਦੇਤ ॥੪੯॥
836.e: ‘And the trees, whose fruit people eat and go home satisfied.’(49)

836.g: ਅਟਪਟਾਇ ਬਾਤੇ ਕਰੈ ਮਿਲ︀ਯੋ ਚਹਤ ਪਿਯ ਸੰਗ ॥
836.e: Talking nonsensically, she was becoming impatient to meet her love.

836.g: ਮੈਨ ਬਾਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਿਧੀ; ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਯੋ ਅੰਗ ॥੫੦॥
836.e: Her each and every limb was demanding, because she was absolutely stung with the passion.(50)

836.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
836.e: Savaiyya

836.g: ਪੌਢਤੀ ਅੰਕ ਪ੍ਰਜੰਕ ਲਲਾ ਕੋ ਲੈ; ਕਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਭਾਖਤ ਜੀ ਕੋ ॥
836.e: (She replied,) ‘Cuddling you I will lie down on the bed and will never divulge this secret to anyone.

836.g: ਕੇਲ ਕਮਾਤ ਬਹਾਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਸਿ; ਮੈਨ ਕਲੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗਤ ਫੀਕੋ ॥
836.e: ‘Frolicking thus, whole night will pass, and, even the Cupids play will seem trivial.

836.g: ਜਾਗਤ ਲਾਜ ਬਢੀ ਤਹ ਮੈ; ਡਰ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਸਜਨੀ, ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕੋ ॥
836.e: ‘I am living on dreams (about you) and wake up afraid of losing you.

836.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਚਾਰਤ ਹੌ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ; ਇਹ ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸਖਿ, ਸੋਵਨ ਨੀਕੋ ॥੪੫॥
836.e: ‘I would rather die, than to wake up from such a dream.’(45)

836.g: ਅੜਿਲ ॥
836.e: Arril Chhand

836.g: ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਤਵ ਰੂਪ ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਪਿਤੁ ਮਾਤ ਤਿਹਾਰੋ ॥
836.e: (He said to her), ‘You are admirable and so are your mother and father.

836.g: ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਦੇਸ ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਨ ਹਾਰੋ ॥
836.e: ‘Your country is commendable and commendable are your sustainers.

836.g: ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਕੁਅਰਿ ਤਵ ਬਕ੍ਰਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
836.e: ‘Your face, which is very pretty, is so meritorious,

836.g: ਹੋ ਜਲਜ ਸੂਰ ਅਰੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ; ਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਲਖਿ ਭਾਜੈ ॥੪੩॥
836.e: ‘That, even, the Lotus- flower, Sun, Moon and Cupid lose their vanity.(43)

836.g: ਸੁਭ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਤਨ ਭਰੇ ਚਾਰੁ; ਚੰਚਲ ਚਖੁ ਸੋਹਹਿ ॥
836.e: ‘Your body is blissful and your eyes are coquettish.

836.g: ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਅਸੁਰ; ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
836.e: ‘You are winsome to all, the birds, deer, beasts, reptiles and demons,

836.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਥਕਿਤ ਰਹਿਤ; ਲਖਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
836.e: ‘Shiva and all his four sons have languished by looking at your eyes.

836.g: ਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ; ਚੁਭਤ ਨਹਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੪੪॥
836.e: ‘But the strange phenomena is that your eyes have not been able to penetrate into my heart.’(44)

836.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
836.e: Chaupaee

836.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੌ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਦੇਤ ਗਹਾਈ ॥੪੧॥
836.e: But if I try to run away, she will get me caught.(41)

836.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਯਾਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੋ ॥
ਚਰਿਤ ਖੇਲਿ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਪਰਹਰੋ ॥
836.e: ‘It will be better if I praise her and through dramatisation get rid of her.

836.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਤਰਨਿ ਜਿਯ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
836.e: ‘Without agreeing to commit sex, she will kill me.

836.g: ਕਵਨ ਸਿਖ︀ਯ ਮੁਹਿ ਆਨਿ ਉਬਾਰੈ ॥੪੨॥
836.e: ‘I wish some disciple of mine could come and save me.’(42)

836.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
836.e: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||

836.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
836.e: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.

836.g: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ. ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ; ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
836.e: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonder and bliss. ||1||Pause||

836.g: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ. ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ; ਮੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
836.e: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I have such a great longing to see my God.

836.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
836.e: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||

836.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
836.e: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.

836.g: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
836.e: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

836.g: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
836.e: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

836.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
836.e: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

836.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ; ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
836.e: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

836.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
836.e: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soul to Him. ||5||

836.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ, ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
836.e: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

836.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
836.e: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

836.g: ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
836.e: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.

836.g: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ. ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
836.e: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

836.g: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ. ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ. ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
836.e: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

836.g: ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
836.e: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

837.g: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ. ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ, ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
837.e: There is one bed for the soul-bride, and the same bed for God, her Lord and Master. The self-willed manmukh does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; she wanders around, in limbo.

837.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ. ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ. ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
837.e: Uttering, "Guru, Guru", she seeks His Sanctuary; so God comes to meet her, without a moment's delay. ||5||

837.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ; ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
837.e: One may perform many rituals, but the mind is filled with hypocrisy, evil deeds and greed.

837.g: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ; ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ. ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
837.e: When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, who can tell the name of his father? ||6||

837.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
837.e: Because of devotional worship in my past incarnations, I have been born into this life. The Guru has inspired me to worship the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

837.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
837.e: Worshipping, worshipping Him with devotion, I found the Lord, and then I merged into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

837.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ; ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥
837.e: God Himself came and ground the henna leaves into powder, and applied it to my body.

837.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
837.e: Our Lord and Master showers His Mercy upon us, and grasps hold of our arms; O Nanak, He lifts us up and saves us. ||8||6||9||2||1||6||9||
Dohira

837.g: ਹਸਿ ਖੇਲੋ, ਸੁਖ ਸੋ ਰਮੋ; ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੋ ਰੋਖ ॥
837.e: (She) ‘Why are you getting so angry, jovially have sex with me.

837.g: ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਹੁਰਾਇ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਹੇਰਤ ਲਗਤ ਨ ਦੋਖ ॥੫੬॥
837.e: ‘My eyes are inviting you, can’t you understand what they are revealing.’ (56)

837.g: ਯਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹੇਰਤ ਨਹੀ; ਸੁਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬੈਨ ॥
837.e: (Raja) ‘Listen, Carefully Listen, I am not looking at you,

837.g: ਲਖੇ ਲਗਨ ਲਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਨ; ਬਡੇ ਬਿਰਹਿਯਾ ਨੈਨ ॥੫੭॥
837.e: ‘Because the looks create the feeling of separation.’(57)
Dohira

837.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਚੋਰ ਕੇ ਬਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ; ਉਠਿਯੋ ਰਾਇ ਡਰ ਧਾਰ ॥
837.e: When the Raja heard the call, “thief, thief” he became dreadful.

837.g: ਭਜਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਡਰ ਪਾਇ ਮਨ; ਪਨੀ ਪਾਮਰੀ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
837.e: He ran out leaving behind his shoes and silk robe.(1)

837.g: ਚੋਰਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਾਗੇ ਸਭੈ; ਭਜੈ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਇ ॥
837.e: Hearing the call of thief, all woke up and did not let the Raja runaway,

837.g: ਕਦਮ ਪਾਚ ਸਾਤਕ ਲਗੇ; ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿਤਾਬੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
837.e: And within five or seven feet they caught him.(2)
Chhape Chhand

837.g: ਦਿਜਨ ਦੀਜਿਯਹੁ ਦਾਨ; ਦ੍ਰੁਜਨ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖੈਯਹੁ ॥
837.e: ‘Charity is endowed to the priests and the men with base thinking get scornful looks.

837.g: ਸੁਖੀ ਰਾਖਿਯਹੁ ਸਾਥ; ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰ ਖੜਗ ਬਜੈਯਹੁ ॥
837.e: ‘Friends are entrained with relief and the enemies get hit on the heads with sword.

837.g: ਲੋਕ ਲਾਜ ਕਉ ਛਾਡਿ; ਕਛੂ ਕਾਰਜ ਨਹਿ ਕਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
837.e: ‘No act is performed keeping in view the public opinion.

837.g: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ; ਪਾਵ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਰਿਯਹੁ ॥
837.e: ‘One should not even dream of getting into bed with else’s wife.

837.g: ਗੁਰ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਇਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਨ ਲਯੋ ਸੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
837.e: ‘Since the time Guru has taught me this lesson,

837.g: ਹੋ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਾਹਨ ਤੁਲਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਪਰ, ਮਾਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੫੮॥
837.e: Any thing belonging to somebody else is like a stone and else’s wife like a mother to me.’(58)

837.g: ਜਰਿ ਬਰਿ ਆਠ ਟੂਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਗਈ ॥
837.e: Listening to all this, she flew into rage and thought,

837.g: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਚੋਰਿ ਚੋਰਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿਹੌ ॥
ਤੁਹਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੀ ਸੁਟਿਹੌ ॥੫੫॥
837.e:
‘Now I should shout, “thief, thief” and people will come and kill
him.’(55)
Chaupaee
His face was hit with shoes and hands were tied tightly.
He was put in the jail, and the woman came back to her bed.(8)

837.g: ਇਹ ਛਲ ਖੇਲਿ ਰਾਇ ਭਜ ਆਯੋ ॥

837.e: Through such a deception, the Raja went free and despatched her brother to the prison.
Dohira

837.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਰਾਵ ਕੋ ਬਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਮਨਿ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
837.e: Listening to the Raja’s talk she became angrier,

837.g: ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਉਠੀ ਸਿਖ︀ਯਨ ਦਿਯੋ ਜਗਾਇ ॥੫੯॥
837.e: And shouting, “thief, thief” she awoke all her companions.(59)

837.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਚੋਰ ਕੋ ਬਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ; ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਿਯੋ ਨਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
837.e: Hearing the call of “thief, thief,” the Raja was frightened.

837.g: ਪਨੀ ਪਾਮਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਭਜ︀ਯੋ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਰਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੬੦॥
837.e: He lost his sanity and, leaving there his shoes and silk robe, ran away.(60)

837.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਇਕੀਸਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੧॥੪੩੯॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
837.e: Twenty-first Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (21)(439)
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
God, please release me from birth and death.
I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.
I grasp Your Feet, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Love of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet to my mind.
Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Twelfth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

837.g: ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਕਹੀ, ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ; ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
837.e: I cannot express the Praises of my God; I cannot express His Praises.
I have abandoned all others, seeking His Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
God's Lotus Feet are Infinite.
I am forever a sacrifice to Them.
My mind is in love with Them.
If I were to abandon Them, there is nowhere else I could go. ||1||
I chant the Lord's Name with my tongue.
The filth of my sins and evil mistakes is burnt off.
Climbing aboard the Boat of the Saints, I am emancipated.
I have been carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
My mind is tied to the Lord with the string of love and devotion.
This is the Immaculate Way of the Saints.
They forsake sin and corruption.
They meet the Formless Lord God. ||3||
Gazing upon God, I am wonderstruck.
I taste the Perfect Flavor of Bliss.
I do not waver or wander here or there.
The Lord God, Har, Har, dwells within my consciousness. ||4||
Those who constantly remember God,
The treasure of virtue, will never go to hell.
Those who listen, fascinated, to the Unstruck Sound-Current of the Word,
Will never have to see the Messenger of Death with their eyes. ||5||
I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Heroic Lord of the World.
The Merciful Lord God is under the power of His devotees.
The Vedas do not know the Mystery of the Lord.
The silent sages constantly serve Him. ||6||
He is the Destroyer of the pains and sorrows of the poor.
It is so very difficult to serve Him.

837.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
837.e: No one knows His limits.
He is pervading the water, the land and the sky. ||7||
Hundreds of thousands of times, I humbly bow to Him.
I have grown weary, and I have collapsed at God's Door.
O God, make me the dust of the feet of the Holy.
Please fulfill this, Nanak's wish. ||8||1||
Chaupaee

837.g: ਚੋਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਧਾਏ ॥

837.e: Others too heard the call of “thief” and came out with their swords.

837.g: ਕੂਕਿ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਹਿ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਦੈਹੈ ॥

837.e: People shouted at him and expressed that he should be sent to the hell.(3)
Dohira

837.g: ਆਗੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ; ਘੇਰਿ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਲੀਨ ॥
837.e: He was rounded up from left, right and all the directions.

837.g: ਪੈਂਡ ਭਜਨ ਕੌ ਨ ਰਹਿਯੋ; ਰਾਇ ਜਤਨ ਯੌ ਕੀਨ ॥੪॥
837.e: Raja did try but he could not find any means (to escape).(4)

837.g: ਵਾ ਕੀ ਕਰ ਦਾਰੀ ਧਰੀ; ਪਗਿਯਾ ਲਈ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
837.e: People pulled his beard and took his turban off

837.g: ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਗਹਿਯੋ; ਦ੍ਵੈਕ ਮੁਤਹਰੀ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
837.e: Calling him “thief, thief” they beat him with sticks.(5)

837.g: ਲਗੇ ਮੁਹਤਰੀ ਕੇ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ; ਭੂਮਿ ਮੂਰਛਨਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
837.e: With the beating of sticks, he fell flat and became unconscious.

837.g: ਭੇਦ ਨ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਨਰ ਲਹਿਯੋ; ਮੁਸਕੈ ਲਈ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੬॥
837.e: People without understanding the real issue, tied him up with a rope.(6)

837.g: ਲਾਤ ਮੁਸਟ ਬਾਜਨ ਲਗੀ ਸਿਖ︀ਯ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ ਆਇ ॥
837.e: They were throwing punches and kicks when the Sikhs arrived, too.

837.g: ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਹਿ ਰਹੀ; ਕੋਊ ਨ ਸਕਿਯੋ ਛੁਰਾਇ ॥੭॥
837.e: The woman shouted, “brother, brother,” but could not rescue him.(7)

838.e: Dohira

838.g: ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਤ ਗੁਰ ਬਕ੍ਰਤ ਤੇ ਸਿਖ︀ਯ ਨ ਸਕੇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥
838.e: Listening to their Guru, the Sikh could not hide (the secret),

838.g: ਪਨੀ ਪਾਮਰੀ ਕੇ ਸਹਿਤ; ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਦਈ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੪॥
838.e: And they told about the woman, the shoe and the robe.(4)
Dohira

838.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਕੋ; ਲੋਗ ਪਰੇ ਅਰਰਾਇ ॥
838.e: Lmmediately, harkening to the Raja, the people hastened to her,

838.g: ਪਨੀ ਪਾਮਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸਹਿਤ ਲ︀ਯਾਵਤ ਭਏ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੬॥
838.e: Brought the woman along with the shoes and the robe.(6)
Chaupaee
Next morning he called the lady, and talked over whole situation.

838.g: ਤੁਮ ਕੁਪਿ ਹਮ ਪਰਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥

838.e: ‘Getting angry on me you tried to caste a net on me but on the contrary I put you in a dilemma.’(10)

838.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬੰਦਿ ਤੇ ਛੋਰਿਯੋ ॥

838.e: ‘You were let out on the pretension of my brother,’ the woman presented distinctive reasoning.

838.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਐਸ ਜਿਯ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਰਿਯਹੁ ॥

838.e: Bilaaval, First Mehl, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days, Tenth House, To The Drum-Beat Jat:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The First Day: The One Universal Creator is unique,
immortal, unborn, beyond social class or involvement.
He is inaccessible and unfathomable, with no form or feature.
Searching, searching, I have seen Him in each and every heart.
None of the Sikhs could comprehend the mystery and they thought her brother to be a thief.(9)

838.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਬਾਈਸਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੨॥੪੪੮॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
838.e: Twenty-second Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (22)(448)
Dohira

838.g: ਪਰ ਪਿਯਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਪਰ ਗਈ; ਨੈਨ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਹੁਰਾਇ ॥
838.e: Her face became pale, and her eyes remained wide open.

838.g: ਧਰਕ ਧਰਕ ਛਤਿਯਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਖ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
838.e: With extreme heart-palpitation, she was dumbfounded.(8)
Arril

838.g: ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹਿਗੇ ਯਾਹਿ; ਨ ਤੁਮ ਕਛੁ ਭਾਖਿਯੋ ॥
838.e: (Raja) ‘I am asking you, and you are keeping quiet.

838.g: ਯਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ; ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਖਿਯੋ ॥
838.e: ‘Alright, I will take you to my house, and keeping you comfortably there,

838.g: ਨਿਰਨੌ ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਏਕ; ਇਕਾਤ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
838.e: ‘I will talk to you in seclusion,

838.g: ਹੋ ਤਬ ਦੈਹੈ ਇਹ ਜਾਨ; ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੯॥
838.e: ‘After that you will be let free.’(9)
Be Merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

838.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
838.e: O Merciful Master of the meek, You are my Lord and Master, O Merciful Master of the meek.
I yearn for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
The world is a pit of poison,
filled with the utter darkness of ignorance and emotional attachment.
Please take my hand, and save me, Dear God.
Please bless me with Your Name, Lord.
Without You, God, I have no place at all.
Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||
The human body is in the grip of greed and attachment.
Without meditating and vibrating upon the Lord, it is reduced to ashes.
The Messenger of Death is dreadful and horrible.
The recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, Chitr and Gupt, know all actions and karma.
Day and night, they bear witness.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||
O Lord, Destroyer of fear and egotism,
be merciful, and save the sinners.
My sins cannot even be counted.
Without the Lord, who can hide them?
I thought of Your Support, and seized it, O my Lord and Master.
Please, give Nanak Your hand and save him, Lord! ||4||
The Lord, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of the world,
cherishes and and sustains every heart.
My mind is thirsty for Your Love, and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my hopes.
I cannot survive, even for an instant.
By great good fortune, Nanak has found the Lord. ||5||
Without You, God, there is no other at all.
My mind loves You, as the partridge loves the moon,
as the fish loves the water,
as the bee and the lotus cannot be separated.
As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,
so does Nanak thirst for the Lord's feet. ||6||
As the young bride places the hopes of her life in her husband,
as the greedy person looks upon the gift of wealth,
as milk is joined to water,
as food is to the very hungry man,
and as the mother loves her son,
so does Nanak constantly remember the Lord in meditation. ||7||
As the moth falls into the lamp,
as the thief steals without hesitation,
as the elephant is trapped by its sexual urges,
as the sinner is caught in his sins,
as the gambler's addiction does not leave him,
so is this mind of Nanak's attached to the Lord. ||8||
As the deer loves the sound of the bell,
and as the song-bird longs for the rain,
the Lord's humble servant lives in the Society of the Saints,
lovingly meditating and vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe.
My tongue chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||9||
One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and hears them, and writes them,
receives all fruits and rewards from the Lord.
He saves all his ancestors and generations,
and crosses over the world-ocean.
The Lord's Feet are the boat to carry him across.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Praises of the Lord.
The Lord protects his honor.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's door. ||10||2||
Arril

838.g: ਕਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ, ਕਿਹ ਕਾਜ, ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਤੈ ਹਰੇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
838.e: (Raja asked,) ‘Tell me pretty lady, why did you steal my garments?

838.g: ਦੇਖ ਭਟਨ ਕੀ ਭੀਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਉਪਜ︀ਯੋ ਨਹਿ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
838.e: ‘Were you not afraid of this group of brave-men (watchmen)?

838.g: ਜੋ ਚੋਰੀ ਜਨ ਕਰੈ ਕਹੌ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਕ︀ਯਾ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥
838.e: ‘You tell me, the one who commits theft, what should be one’s punishments.

838.g: ਹੋ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਟਰੌ; ਨਾਤਰ ਜਿਯ ਤੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਮਰਿਯੈ ॥੭॥
838.e: ‘Any way, in consideration of your being a lady, I let you go free, otherwise I would have executed you.’(7)
Chaupaee

838.g: ਭਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥

838.e: As the Sun rose, people awoke and went to their respective occupations.
The Raja came out of his palace and seated on his throne.(1)
Dohira

838.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਭਏ ਤਵਨੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ; ਹਿਤ ਤਜਿ ਰਿਸ ਉਪਜਾਇ ॥
838.e: Next day, early in the morning that lady got up,

838.g: ਪਨੀ ਪਾਮਰੀ ਜੋ ਹੁਤੇ; ਸਭਹਿਨ ਦਏ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
838.e: And displayed the shoes and the robe publicly.(2)
Chaupaee
The Raja declared in the court that somebody had stolen his shoes and robe.

838.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਿਕਟ ਨਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
838.e: ‘The Sikh, who will find them out for me, will be saved from the clutches of Death.’(3)
Chaupaee
The Raja ordered thus, ‘Go and get her and also bring my shoes and robe.

838.g: ਮੋਰਿ ਕਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਦੈਯਹੁ ॥੫॥
838.e: ‘Bring her straight to me without reprimanding her.’(5)

839.e: ‘Never try to attempt such trickery ever again and this time I pardon your transgression.’(11)

839.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
839.e: I am a sacrifice to one who sees, and inspires others to see Him.
By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||1||
Whose Name should I chant, and meditate on, except the Lord of the Universe?

839.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
839.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed within the home of one's own heart. ||1||Pause||
The Second Day: Those who are in love with another, come to regret and repent.
The are tied up at Death's door, and continue coming and going.

839.g: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ; ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
839.e: What have they brought, and what will they take with them when they go?
The Messenger of Death looms over their heads, and they endure his beating.
Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one finds release.
Practicing hypocrisy, no one finds liberation. ||2||
The True Lord Himself created the universe, joining the elements together.
Breaking the cosmic egg, He united, and separated.

839.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ; ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
839.e: He made the earth and the sky into places to live.
He created day and night, fear and love.
The One who created the Creation, also watches over it.
There is no other Creator Lord. ||3||
The Third Day: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
the gods, goddesses and various manifestations.
The lights and forms cannot be counted.
The One who fashioned them, knows their value.
He evaluates them, and totally pervades them.
Who is close, and who is far away? ||4||
The Fourth Day: He created the four Vedas,
the four sources of creation, and distinct forms of speech.
He created the eighteen Puraanas, the six Shaastras and the three qualities.
He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.
One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.

839.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
839.e: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||
The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.
The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.
Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.
Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.

839.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
839.e: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.

839.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ; ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
839.e: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever-present. ||6||
The false one has no honor or fame;
like the black crow, he never becomes pure.
He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;
he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.
He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.
He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||
The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.
The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.

839.g: ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
839.e: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.
One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.

839.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ; ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
839.e: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.
Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||
The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,
the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.
Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,

839.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
839.e: one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.
With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,
one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||
The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,
and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.
Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,
and concentrate on the pure True Name.

839.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
839.e: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,
prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

839.e: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga,
The nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart.
Dohira

839.e: How could she tolerate and contain herself when the arrows of estrangement pinched her?

839.e: The father again sent his son to the prison,

This whole world is the child of Maya.
I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.
He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.
He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||
The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.
Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.

840.g: ਸਚਿ. ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
840.e: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.
The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.
Know that the world is just like this thread.
Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||
The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.
Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.
Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.
One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.
The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.
The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||
Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.
He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.
Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.
Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.
In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.
The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||
The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,
remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.
He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.

840.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
840.e: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.
Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies
- prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||
The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.
Bring your out-going mind back home.
Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.
Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.
Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.
Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||
The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.
But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

840.g: ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
840.e: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.
Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.

840.g: ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ; ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
840.e: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.
He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||
The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,
overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.
Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,
and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.
He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds,
The nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||
Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.
O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.
Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.

840.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
840.e: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||

One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.
Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.
The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.
Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one,

840.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
840.e: Who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1||

840.e: After mouth washing, he sat down besides the spring in deep contemplation,

841.e: ‘Tell me, tell me, whatever transpired between you,

Bilaaval, Third Mehl, The Seven Days, Tenth House:

841.e: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.
He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.
Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.
Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.

Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

841.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ, ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
841.e: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Grasping the feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.

841.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.

He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

841.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.
He worships the Lord in loving devotion.
His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||
Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.
The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.

841.e: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.
In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.
Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.
The Great Giver Himself gives it.

841.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
841.e: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.
By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.
O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.
I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||

All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.
God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.
O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.
The beings and creatures are under Your protection.
He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||

He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.
One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.
He practices truth and self-restraint.
Without genuine understanding, all fasts,

841.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
841.e: Religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||

in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.
The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.
Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.
By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.
He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.
They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord.
Chaupaee

841.e: ‘In all his four arms, four hands were ensconed,

841.g: ਨਵਲ ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਗੋਪੀ ਨਵਲ; ਨਵਲ ਸਖਾ ਲਿਯੇ ਸੰਗ ॥
841.e: ‘The handsome Kahan (Krishna) had pretty female-companions a maids.

841.g: ਨਵਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਮੈ ਧਰੇ; ਰੰਗਿਤ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੰਗ ॥੩੮॥
841.e: ‘They all had adorned beautiful and novel clothes.’(38)

841.g: ਇਹੈ ਭੇਖ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੋ; ਯਾ ਮੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਭੇਦ ॥
841.e: (She said) ‘There is no doubt that he was the epitome of Bhagwan,

841.g: ਇਹੈ ਉਚਾਰਤ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ; ਇਹੈ ਬਖਾਨਤ ਬੇਦ ॥੩੯॥
841.e: And the Vedas and the Shastras stand testimony to that.(39)

841.g: ਇਹੈ ਭੇਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹੈ; ਇਹੈ ਕਹਤ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
ਦਰਸੁ ਦਯੋ ਜਦੁਪਤਿ ਤੁਮੈ; ਯਾ ਮੈ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
841.e: As Pundits had said that, as such, was confirmed by everyone else.’( 40)
Chhand

841.g: ਪੀਤ ਬਸਨ ਬਨਮਾਲ; ਮੋਰ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਟ ਸੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
841.e: ‘The yellow robes, garlands of flowers around the neck and peacock- crown on the head, were exalting.

841.g: ਮੁਖ ਮੁਰਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਫਬਤ; ਹਿਯੇ ਕੌਸਤਭ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
841.e: ‘With a flute on his mouth, he had the (legendry) jewel of Kaustik (auspiciously churned out of the sea) in his heart.

841.g: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਸੁਦਰਸਨ ਗਦਾ; ਹਾਥ ਨੰਦਗ ਅਸਿ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
841.e: ‘He had beautiful bow, elegant quoits and double-edged sword in his hands

841.g: ਲਖੇ ਸਾਵਰੀ ਦੇਹ; ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਸਾਵਨ ਲਾਜੈ ॥੩੬॥
841.e: ‘Seeing his dark complexion, even the rainy-season cloud felt timidity.(36)
Chaupaee
The hearsay reached the town
And the Rani heard it thoughtfully.
Sitting in palanquin she started to go to that place,
And she took with her twenty-twenty five of her friends.(28)
Chaupaee

841.g: ਕਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਤੁਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
ਕਵਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
841.e: ‘You have been endowed with the vision of Siam (Krishna),
‘Please let me listen to your anecdotes to console my heart.(30)
Dohira

841.g: ਧਾਮ ਚਲੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
841.e: (They begged) ‘Please be benevolent and come to our domains.

841.g: ਹਮ ਠਾਢੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਏਕ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਰਧਾਰ ॥੪੨॥
841.e: ‘We will render service even if we had to perform by standing on our one leg.’ (42)

841.g: ਰਾਨੀ, ਸੁਤ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਿਯੈ; ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਤਬ ਦੇਸ ॥
841.e: (He said) ‘Oh Rani! Long live your offspring and be your country very prosperous.

841.g: ਹਮ ਅਤੀਤ ਬਨ ਹੀ ਭਲੇ; ਧਰੇ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ਭੇਸ ॥੪੩॥
841.e: ‘We are quite satisfied here, living like a hermit.’( 43)
Chaupaee

841.g: ਯੌ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਸਕਲ ਹੀ ਧਾਏ ॥
841.e: Hearing this the people swarmed to the place,
And with them they brought sweetmeats and snacks
They presented him milk and rice,
And, through numerous ways, paid their obeisance at his feet.(25)
(People said) ‘You had the vision of Krishna,
‘And, thus you have become a prominent Guru.

841.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹਮ ਕਰਹੀ ॥
841.e: ‘Now, as we esteem you very high,

841.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਬੰਦ ਨ ਪਰਹੀ ॥੨੬॥
841.e: ‘You emancipate us from the (fear of) death.(26)
Chaupaee
(He replied) ‘I had come here for an ablution, and after’ taking bath I contemplated.

841.g: ਇਕ ਚਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਜਪੁ ਜਬ ਕਿਯੋ ॥

841.e: ‘When I sought His divination with great determination, then Shri Krishna came into my vision.(32)

841.g: ਸੁਨੁ ਅਬਲਾ, ਮੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥

841.e: ‘Listen, you the lady in distress, I don’t remember what did he con fen upon me.

841.g: ਮੈ ਲਖਿ ਰੂਪ ਅਚਰਜ ਤਬ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਮੋ ਕਹ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਸਭੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਗਯੋ ॥੩੩॥
841.e: ‘I was astounded with his radiant sight and I lost all my senses.(33)
Dohira

841.g: ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਧਰੀ; ਪੀਤ ਬਸਨ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
841.e: ‘With a garland of wild flowers around and yellow clothes on, He came.

841.g: ਨਿਰਖ ਦਿਪਤ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਲਜੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਨ ਬਰਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
841.e: ‘As even the lightening faltered on his sight, I was astounded to see him.(34)
Dohira

841.g: ਚਲੀ ਚਲੀ ਆਈ ਤਹਾ; ਜਹਾ ਹੁਤੇ ਨਿਜੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
841.e: Walking along she reached the place where there was her friend.

841.g: ਭਾਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਇਨ ਪਰੀ; ਅਧਿਕ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਚੀਤ ॥੨੯॥
841.e: Bowing down on his feet, she begged for the peace of mind.(29)

842.e: Dohira

842.g: ਕੈਲਾਖਰ ਕੇ ਰਾਵ ਕੀ; ਏਕ ਹੁਤੀ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
842.e: The Raja of Kailakhar had a very pretty lady.

842.g: ਰਾਜ ਨਸਟ ਕੇ ਹੇਤੁ ਤਿਨ; ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਕਿਯਾ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
842.e: Once in her mind she contemplated of destroying the monarchy.(3)
Chaupaee

842.g: ਰਾਜ ਧਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਦੈਯੈ ॥
842.e: (She thought) ‘I should conduct some manoeuvring and should not let the throne slip out of my hands.

842.g: ਪੂਤ ਅਨਤ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਯੈ ॥

842.e: ‘I should get child through some body else and announce it to be of Raja.’(6)

842.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੋ, ਕਰਿਹੋ ਅਬ ਸੋਈ ॥
ਤਵ ਆਗ︀ਯਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪੪॥
842.e: ‘I will render every service to your desire and will never evade.’(44)
Dohira

842.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਯਾ ਕੇ ਭਯੋ; ਬਿਰਧ ਗਯੋ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਾਇ ॥
842.e: The Raja had no issue and he was getting old.

842.g: ਕੇਲ ਕਲਾ ਤੈ ਥਕਿ ਗਯੋ; ਸਕਤ ਨ ਸੁਤ ਉਪਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
842.e: He had lacked sexual potency and was unable to produce a child.(5)
Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.
The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.
The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.
Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.
Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||
One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead

842.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
842.e: - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||
He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.
No one can erase Your record, Lord.

842.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
842.e: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,
he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.
That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.
Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||
From the One Lord, all others were formed.
The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.
Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.

842.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
842.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.
Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.
Duality is subdued within. ||3||
One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master

842.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ; ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
842.e: no one can destroy him.
The Lord's servant remains under His protection;
The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.
There is none higher than Him.

842.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ; ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
842.e: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||
Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.

842.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਪੀਰ ॥
842.e: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.

842.g: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
842.e: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.
My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||
Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.
The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.

842.g: ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
842.e: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.
Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.
In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||
All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.
If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.
The omens and days all come and go.
But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one merges in the True Lord.

842.g: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ; ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
842.e: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.
Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||
The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.
They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.
The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.
Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?
The Creator Himself creates.
He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||
The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.
They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.
They find no peace, here or hereafter.
Chaupaee

842.g: ਤਵਨ ਜਾਰ ਕੋ ਸੰਗ ਲੈ ਚਲੀ ॥

842.e: Then she brought her paramour to her home along with other fifty friends.
With sweet talks, she impressed all, and, then making them to leave, she enjoyed sex-plays.(47)
Dohira

842.g: ਤਵਨ ਜਾਰ ਸੌ ਯੌ ਰਹੈ; ਨਿਜੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਜਿਯੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
842.e: The lover lived there as if he was living with his own wife.

842.g: ਲੋਗ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਹਿ ਪਗ ਪਰੈ; ਭੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪੮॥
842.e: But the people considered him Guru and did not understand inner secret.(48)

842.g: ਚੰਚਲਾਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ; ਸਕਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਇ ॥
842.e: No one can understand the cryptic character of women,

842.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੂਰ ਸੁਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਸਭ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸਨ ਸੁਰ ਰਾਇ ॥੪੯॥
842.e: Not even Sun, Moon, gods, demons, Brahma, Vishnu and Indra.(49)(1)

842.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਚੌਬੀਸਮੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੪॥੫੦੯॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
842.e: Twenty-fourth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (24)(509)
You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.
Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.
The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||
The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,
the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;
so the world goes on.
Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.
The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.

842.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
842.e: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1||
Dohira

842.g: ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਭੀਤਰ ਬਸੈ; ਕੈਲਾਖਰ ਦੀ ਦੂਨ ॥
842.e: There exists a valley at Kailakhar, at the confluence of the River Jamuna and the Rives Ganga.

842.g: ਤਿਹ ਠਾ ਲੋਗ ਬਸੈ ਘਨੈ; ਪ੍ਰਤਛ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਜੂਨ ॥੧॥
842.e: The people of that place lived a life of destitute, like the animals.(1)
Chaupaee

842.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੁਅਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
ਬਿਰਧ ਰਾਵ ਲਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਡਰ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
842.e: Prem Kumari was the name of that Rani.

842.g: ਯਾ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਏਕ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
842.e: Observing the Raja’s old age, she was always apprehensive.

842.g: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
842.e: One factor always worried her  the Raja had no male issue.( 4)
Dohira

842.g: ਮੈ ਯਾ ਸੋ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰੋ; ਕਹਿ ਅਲਿ ਦਈ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
842.e: ‘I will have a talk with him alone, saying so she made all the others to leave the place.

842.g: ਆਪੁ ਆਇ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਰਮੀ; ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਖ ਉਪਜਾਇ ॥੪੫॥
842.e: Then, herself, started to quench the thirst of her heart.(45)

842.g: ਲੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਘਰ ਚਲੀ; ਮਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ॥
842.e: She felt homely with him, and commenced favourite sex-plays.

842.g: ਯਾਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਯੋ ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਕਹੈ; ਭੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥੪੬॥
842.e: ‘I will have a talk with him alone, saying so she made all the others to the secret.(46)
Dohira

842.g: ਗਰਭਵਤੀ ਇਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਹੁਤੀ; ਲੀਨੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
842.e: There was a pregnant lady, which she called to her house.

842.g: ਰਨਿਯਹਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਅਧਾਨ ਜਗ; ਐਸੇ ਦਈ ਉਡਾਇ ॥੭॥
842.e: She let loose the rumour that the Rani was pregnant.(7)

842.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਦਰਬ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਦਯੋ; ਮੋਲ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਹ ਲੀਨ ॥
842.e: She paid lot of money to that lady and bought her son.

842.g: ਸੁਤ ਉਪਜ︀ਯੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਯੌ ਕਹਿ ਉਤਸਵ ਕੀਨ ॥੮॥
842.e: The announcement of the birth of son of Raja gave her immense satisfaction.(8)

842.g: ਡੋਮ ਭਾਟ ਢਾਢੀਨ ਕੌ; ਦੀਨਾ ਦਰਬੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
842.e: She gave out abundant amounts in alms to the Bards and Minstrels
Chaupaee
The Minister said, ‘Listen My most cherished Majesty,
‘Now 1 will tell you the story which will illuminate all your anxieties.’(2)

843.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
843.e: Chaupaee

843.g: ਕਿਤਕ ਦਿਨਨ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਯੋ ॥
ਰਾਵ ਸੁ ਸੇਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਤਹ ਭਯੋ ॥
843.e: After some times the Raja breathed his last.

843.g: ਰਾਵ ਰਾਵ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧੦॥
843.e: Though vile gestures, she declared that inferior character as the Raja and none new the secret.(10)

843.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
843.e: Chaupaee

843.g: ਬਨਿਕ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
ਘਾਸ ਦਾਤ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥
843.e: Hearing this he took his clothes off, and started to nimble the grass (and said),

843.g: ਸੁਨ ਤਸਕਰ, ਮੈ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਹਾਰੋ ॥
ਜਾਨਿ ਆਪਨੋ ਆਜੁ ਉਬਾਰੋ ॥੧੦॥
843.e: ‘Listen, the swindler, I am your servant, today please pardon and Spare my life.(10)

843.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ; ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
843.e: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

843.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
843.e: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

843.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
843.e: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

843.g: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
843.e: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

843.g: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ; ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
843.e: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

843.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
843.e: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

843.g: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ; ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
843.e: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

843.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
843.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

843.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
843.e: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

843.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
843.e: Dohira

843.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਤਿ, ਜੁਧ ਕਰਹੁ ਡਰ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
843.e: ‘Where are you, the fool, going? Come and fight with me,

843.g: ਮਾਰਤ ਹੋ ਨਹਿ ਆਜੁ ਤੁਹਿ; ਪਗਿਯਾ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
843.e: ‘Otherwise, taking your turban and clothes away, I will kill you.’(9)

843.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
843.e: Chaupaee

843.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬਨਿਕ ਬਨਿਜ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਬੀਸ ਚੋਰ ਅਬ ਹਨੇ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
843.e: Whenever, the moneylender came back (from business), he boasted,

843.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਆਨਿ ਇਮਿ ਬਚਨ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥
843.e: ‘1 have killed twenty thieves’.

843.g: ਤੀਸ ਚੋਰ ਮੈ ਆਜੁ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
843.e: Some times he would come and say, ‘I have killed thirty thieves.’(2)

843.g: ਐਸੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਹੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਬੈਨ ਮੋਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
843.e: Every time he bragged as such, wife would just keep quiet.

843.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਪਰ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
ਏ ਸਭ ਬਾਤ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
843.e: She would not contradict him at his face, and restrained her reaction.(3)

843.g: ਨਿਰਤ ਮਤੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਬ ਕਿਯੋ ॥
ਬਾਜਸਾਲ ਤੇ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਲਿਯੋ ॥
843.e: Nirat Mati (that lady) devised a scheme and sent for a horse from the stable.

843.g: ਬਾਧਿ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰ ਖੜਗ ਨਚਾਯੋ ॥
ਸਕਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੋ ਭੇਸ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥੪॥
843.e: With sword in her hand and a turban on her head, she disguised herself as a man.(4)

843.g: ਦਹਿਨੇ ਹਾਥ ਸੈਹਥੀ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤੀਰ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ਕੋਹੈ ॥
843.e: With a sword embellishing in her right hand, she would appear to be a soldier,

843.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਾਜ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਬਨੀ ॥
ਜਾਨੁਕ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਪਤਿ ਅਨੀ ॥੫॥
843.e: Dressing herself as a man, she looked like chief of the army.(5)

843.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
843.e: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

843.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ; ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

843.g: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

843.g: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ; ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
843.e: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

843.g: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
843.e: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.

843.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
843.e: Dohira

843.g: ਕਰਮ ਰੇਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੁਤੇ; ਭਏ ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਇ ॥
843.e: This is how destiny prevailed, a destitute bacame Raja, she fulfilled her designs,

843.g: ਰਾਵਤ ਤੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
843.e: And no one realised her deceptive Chritar.(11)(1)

843.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਪਚੀਸਮੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੫॥੫੨੦॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
843.e: Twenty-fifth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (25)(520)

843.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
843.e: Dohira

843.g: ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਊ ਬਨਿਕ ਕੀ; ਸੁਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ, ਤੁਹਿ ਸੰਗ ॥
843.e: Now, listen my Raja, I narrate to you the story of a moneylender,

843.g: ਇਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ; ਬੁਰਿ ਪਰ ਖੁਦ੍ਰਯੋ ਬਿਹੰਗ ॥੧॥
843.e: How a lady in the woods tattooed a bird on his rectum.(1)

843.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
843.e: Chaupaee

843.g: ਬਨਿਕ ਜਾਤ ਏਕਲੌ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
ਛਲੋ ਯਾਹਿ ਯੌ ਬਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
843.e: Seeing him going all alone, she made up her mind to beguile him

843.g: ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਧਾਈ ॥
ਕਾਢਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਪਹੂੰਚੀ ਆਈ ॥੮॥
843.e: Performing fighting feats she came and unleashed the sword.(8)

843.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
843.e: Dohira.

843.g: ਸਿਪਰ ਸਰੋਹੀ ਸੈਹਥੀ; ਧੁਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
843.e: Bedecked with a sword, a shield, a spear, and a flag, instead of a fernale.

843.g: ਮਹਾਬੀਰ ਸੀ ਜਾਨਿਯੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਨ ਸਮਝੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
843.e: She reflected herself to be a great warrior.(6)

843.g: ਬਨਿਜ ਹੇਤ ਬਨਿਯਾ ਚਲਿਯੋ; ਅਤਿ ਹਰਖਤ ਸਭ ਅੰਗ ॥
843.e: The moneylender was satisfied in all respects,

843.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੀਤ ਸੁਭ; ਬਨ ਮੈ ਧਸਿਯੋ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥੭॥
843.e: And had proceeded jovially towards the woods, singing all the way.(7)

843.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
843.e: Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chhant, Dakhnee:

843.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
843.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

843.g: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ; ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

843.g: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

843.g: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
843.e: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

843.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ. ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
843.e: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

843.g: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
843.e: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

843.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ; ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ. ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
843.e: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

843.g: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ; ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

843.g: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ; ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

843.g: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ; ਮੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
843.e: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

843.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ; ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
843.e: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

843.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ; ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
843.e: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

843.g: ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ, ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
843.e: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

843.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ; ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ. ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

843.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ; ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

843.g: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
843.e: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

843.g: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
843.e: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

843.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
843.e: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

843.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
843.e: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

843.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

843.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.e: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

843.g: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
843.e: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

843.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
843.e: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

843.g: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ; ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
843.e: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

843.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
843.e: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

843.g: ਸੇਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਧਰਿਯੋ; ਸਭਹਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਾਰ ॥੯॥
843.e: (And on the birth of the child) she named him Sher Singh.(9)

844.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
844.e: Chaupaee

844.g: ਕੰਕ ਨਾਮ ਦਿਜਬਰ ਇਕ ਸੁਨਾ ॥
ਪੜ੍ਰਹੇ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
844.e: There lived one Brahmin named Kanak, who was well versed in Shastras and Puranas.

844.g: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
ਸੂਰ ਲਯੋ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਉਜਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
844.e: He was handsome too and, even, the Sun borrowed light from him.(1)

844.g: ਦਿਜ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਬ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਗ ਅਸੁਰ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
844.e: His attractiveness was so distinguished that the gods, humans, reptiles and demons relished him

844.g: ਲਾਬੇ ਕੇਸ ਛਕੇ ਘੁੰਘਰਾਰੇ ॥
844.e: His attractiveness was so distinguished that the gods, humans, reptiles and demons relished him

844.g: ਨੈਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਬਨੇ ਕਟਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
844.e: He had long and wavy hair and his eyes were like those of katara, the killer bird.(2) .

844.g: ਬ︀ਯੋਮ ਕਲਾ ਰਾਨੀ ਰਸ ਭਰੀ ॥
ਬਿਰਧ ਰਾਇ ਸੁਤ ਹਿਤ ਜਰੀ ॥
844.e: There was a Rani by the name of Biyom Kala, whose husband was old and she had no issues.

844.g: ਤਿਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਭੋਗ ਕੰਕ ਸੌ ਚਹਾ ॥
844.e: There was a Rani by the name of Biyom Kala, whose husband was old and she had no issues.

844.g: ਲਏ ਕਪੂਰ ਆਵਤੋ ਗਹਾ ॥੩॥
844.e: As she wished to have sex with Kanak, holding camphor she took him in her arms.(3) . .

844.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਦਿਜਬਰ ਸੋ ਬਚਨ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥
ਭਜਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਮੈ ਪਿਯਾਰੇ ॥
844.e: The lady said to the twice born (Brahmm), today you love me.

844.g: ਕੰਕ ਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ਕਹੀ ॥
ਰਾਨੀ ਬਾਹਿ ਜੋਰ ਤਨ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥
844.e: Kanak did not heed to her but she took him in her arms.(4)

844.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
844.e: Dohira

844.g: ਰੂਪ ਕੁਰੂਪ ਅਹੀਰ ਕੋ; ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
844.e: An ugly looking milkman possessed this pretty wife.

844.g: ਵਹੁ ਤਰੁਨੀ ਇਕ ਰਾਵ ਕੋ; ਅਟਕੀ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
844.e: On seeing a Raja, she fell in love with him.(2)

844.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
844.e: Chaupaee

844.g: ਅਨਤ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਇਕ ਕਹੀ ॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਸਭ ਸਭਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਹੀ ॥
844.e: The Minister narrated another story, listening to which whole assembly became silence.

844.g: ਏਕ ਅਹੀਰ ਨਦੀ ਤਟ ਰਹਈ ॥
844.e: The Minister narrated another story, listening to which whole assembly became silence.

844.g: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਜਗ ਕਹਈ ॥੧॥
844.e: A milkman used to live at the bank of a stream; His wife was considered the most beautiful.(1)

844.g: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
844.e: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.

844.g: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
844.e: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, I hold tight to the Truth. ||1||

844.g: ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ; ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,

844.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ; ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

844.g: ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ, ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ; ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ. ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
844.e: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

844.g: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ; ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
844.e: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.

844.g: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
844.e: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.

844.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
844.e: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||

844.g: ਜਾਗੁ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ; ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

844.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ; ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

844.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
844.e: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

844.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
844.e: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worlds are revealed to her understanding.

844.g: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
844.e: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of the Lord.

844.g: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
844.e: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within his heart. ||3||

844.g: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ; ਭਗਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Lover of His devotees.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ; ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.

844.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
844.e: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself, and realize the Lord of the three worlds.

844.g: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ; ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
844.e: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know her Husband Lord.

844.g: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
844.e: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength and anchor.

844.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਓ ॥੪॥੨॥
844.e: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conflicts are resolved. ||4||2||

844.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
844.e: Dohira

844.g: ਗਹਿ ਚੁੰਬਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਰਨ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਨਿਕਸਯਾ ਆਇ ॥
844.e: When, holding him, she was kissing him, the Raja walked in.

844.g: ਤਬ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਕ; ਅਧਿਕ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਸਕੁਚਾਇ ॥੫॥
844.e: Being ashamed, then, the lady staged a trickery.(5)

844.g: ਯਾ ਦਿਜਬਰ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੀ; ਸੁਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਮ ਸੂਰ ॥
844.e: ‘I had felt some doubt in the intention of this Brahmin,

844.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਨ ਚੋਰਿ ਭਖ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਛੂ; ਸੁੰਘਨ ਹੁਤੀ ਕਪੂਰ ॥੬॥
844.e: ‘I was trying to detect the smell of camphor in his mouth.’(6)

844.g: ਸੂਰ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੂਰਿ ਮਤਿ; ਅਤਿ ਹਰਖਤ ਭਯੋ ਜੀਯ ॥
844.e: Hearing this the foolish Raja was satisfied,

844.g: ਸੀਂਘਤ ਹੁਤੀ ਕਪੂਰ ਕਹ ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਧੰਨ︀ਯ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਯ ॥੭॥
844.e: And started to shower the praises on the lady smelling camphor.(7)(1)

844.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਸਤਾਈਸਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੭॥੫੪੦॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
844.e: Twenty-seventh Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (27)(540)

844.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
844.e: Dohira

844.g: ਜੌ ਅਪਨੀ ਤੈ ਗੁਦਾ ਪਰ; ਖੋਦਨ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਹੰਗ ॥
844.e: ‘If you let me tattoo a bird on your rectum,

844.g: ਤੋ ਤੁਮ ਅਬ ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹੋ; ਬਚੈ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਗ ॥੧੧॥
844.e: ‘Only then you can save your life.’(11)

844.g: ਤਬੈ ਬਨਿਕ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਿਯਾ ਜ︀ਯੋਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
844.e: The moneylender agreed to do whatever the lady said.

844.g: ਥਰਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਛਿਤ ਪਰ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਖ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
844.e: He fell flat on his chest and shut his mouth tightly.(l2)

844.g: ਤਬੁ ਤਰੁਨੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਉਤਰਿ; ਇਕ ਛੁਰਕੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ॥
844.e: Then the lady dismounted the horse and took a knife,

844.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਨੈ ਤਿਹ ਬਨਿਕ ਕੀ; ਬੁਰਿ ਪਰ ਖੁਦ੍ਰਯੋ ਬਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੩॥
844.e: As Ram Bhanai (the poet) said, the lady tattooed a bird.(13) (1)

844.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਛਬੀਸਮੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨੬॥੫੩੩॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
844.e: Twenty-sixth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (26)(533)

844.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
844.e: Chaupaee

844.g: ਦੁਖਤ ਅਹੀਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੋ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
ਕਟੁ ਕਟੁ ਬਚਨ ਰੈਨ ਦਿਨ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
844.e: The milkman had kept the woman under distress and, day in and day out, used to beat her.

844.g: ਗੋਰਸ ਬੇਚਨ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
844.e: The milkman had kept the woman under distress and, day in and day out, used to beat her.

844.g: ਛੀਨਿ ਬੇਚਿ ਗਹਨਨ ਕਹ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
844.e: He would not let her go to sell even the milk and he had snatched her ornaments and sold them.(3)

844.g: ਅੜਿਲ ॥
844.e: Arril

844.g: ਸੂਰਛਟ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮ; ਤਰੁਨਿ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਯੈ ॥
ਛੰਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
844.e: Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

844.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
844.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

844.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ; ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.

844.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.

844.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.

844.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
844.e: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||

844.g: ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself by Himself.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.

844.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਕਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the color of His Love.

844.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
844.e: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

844.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time to contemplate the Lord.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.

844.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਿਨੑ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.

844.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
844.e: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||

844.g: ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.e: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love.

845.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
845.e: Chaupaee

845.g: ਗੋਰਸ ਦੁਹਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਹਿ ਤਹ ਲ︀ਯਾਵੈ ॥
ਸਮੈ ਪਾਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
845.e: She used to bring buffaloes there for milking and at the same time Raja would reach there as well.

845.g: ਦੁਹਤ ਛੀਰਿ ਕਟਿਯਾ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਈ ॥
845.e: She used to bring buffaloes there for milking and at the same time Raja would reach there as well.

845.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਹ ਭਾਖਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਈ ॥੫॥
845.e: Whenever the calf troubled the milk-man, he used to call her to hold it (the calf).(5)

845.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
845.e: Dohira

845.g: ਪੈਰਿ ਨਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਰ ਕੋ; ਉਠਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਤਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
845.e: Swimming across the river, the Raja used to go to see her, And used

845.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੋ; ਭਜਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
845.e: To revel with that woman in various ways.(4)

845.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
845.e: Dohira

845.g: ਦੁਤਿਯਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਰ; ਰਾਜ ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
845.e: The learned Minister, who was adept in statesmanship,

845.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਿਕਟ; ਕਥਾ ਬਖਾਨੀ ਆਨਿ ॥੨॥
845.e: Narrated, once again, the story to Raja Chiter Singh.(2)

845.g: ਛੰਤ ॥
845.e: Chhant:

845.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.

845.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovingly attuned to her Lord, Har, Har.

845.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritual wisdom has been awakened within her.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
845.e: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||

845.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.

845.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har, Har.

845.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ; ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
845.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord's Name. ||2||

845.g: ਧਨ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਰਾਵੀਆ; ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

845.g: ਅਖੀ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ; ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਕ ਮਸਾਈ, ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.

845.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence of the Lord.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
845.e: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

845.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united me with Himself.

845.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

845.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.e: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.
