Give up your envy of others, you fool!
You only live here for a night, you fool!

889.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਤੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
889.e: You are intoxicated with Maya, but you must soon arise and depart.

889.g: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.e: You are totally involved in the dream. ||1||Pause||
In his childhood, the child is blind.
In the fullness of youth, he is involved in foul-smelling sins.
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Meeting with the Sangat, the Congregation, the Supreme Lord God has come into my consciousness.
In the Sangat, my mind has found contentment.
I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints.
Countless times, I humbly bow to the Saints. ||1||
This mind is a sacrifice to the Saints;

889.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.e: holding tight to their support, I have found peace, and in their mercy, they have protected me. ||1||Pause||
I wash the feet of the Saints, and drink in that water.
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, I live.
My mind rests its hopes in the Saints.
The Saints are my immaculate wealth. ||2||
The Saints have covered my faults.

889.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਕੜਦਾ ॥
889.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I am no longer tormented.
The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the Saints' Congregation.
The Compassionate Saints have become my help and support. ||3||
My consciousness, intellect and wisdom have been enlightened.
The Lord is profound, unfathomable, infinite, the treasure of virtue.
He cherishes all beings and creatures.
Nanak is enraptured, seeing the Saints. ||4||10||21||
Dohira

889.g: ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਭੂਪ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ॥
889.e: On seeing him (her) the Raja lost his sensibility.

889.g: ਕੌਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਯਹ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥੧੬॥
889.e: ‘Whose son is he? You call him here before me.’(16)
They obtain a permanent seat in the infinite. ||2||

889.g: ਡਿਗਿ. ਨ ਡੋਲੈ; ਕਤਹੂ. ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
889.e: No one falls there, or wavers, or goes anywhere.

889.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
889.e: By Guru's Grace, some find this mansion.

889.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
889.e: They are not touched by doubt, fear, attachment or the traps of Maya.
They enter the deepest state of Samaadhi, through the kind mercy of God. ||3||
He has no end or limitation.
He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

889.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥
889.e: One who enjoys the taste of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within himself,
O Nanak, his wondrous state cannot be described. ||4||9||20||
Chaupaee
The soldiers tied the prince up and all the people from the town came to see.

889.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਿਯੋ ॥

889.e: When they passed by the Rajas’ palace, the Raja noticed as well.(14)
That damsel called for a Turkish horse and disguised herself as a man.
She adorned hundred thousand worth of ornaments and put on black dress.(15)
Dohira

889.g: ਕੋਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਉਚਰੈ; ਰਮਤ ਦੋਊ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
889.e: They both savoured by following the Koka-shastra,

889.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਆਸਨ ਕਰੈ; ਗਨਨਾ ਗਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
889.e: And adopting various positions, which could not be counted.(12)

889.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਸਿ ਚਲਿਯੋ; ਗਹਿਯੋ ਪਯਾਦਨ ਆਇ ॥
889.e: The night passed and at the daybreak, police came.

889.g: ਬਾਧਿ ਹਨਨ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ; ਰਹਿਯੋ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
889.e: They tied him and took him to kill as there was no other way.(l3)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

889.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
889.e: Your home, power and wealth will be of no use to you.
Your corrupt worldly entanglements will be of no use to you.
Know that all your dear friends are fake.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
889.e: Only the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, will go along with you. ||1||

889.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਹੈ ॥
889.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord in meditation, your honor shall be saved.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮੁ ਕਛੁ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.e: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Messenger of Death will not touch you. ||1||Pause||
Without the Lord, all pursuits are useless.
Gold, silver and wealth are just dust.

889.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾਪਿ; ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
889.e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, your mind shall be at peace.
Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||2||
Even the greatest of the great worked and worked until they were exhausted.

889.g: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ. ਨ ਕੀਏ; ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
889.e: None of them ever accomplished the tasks of Maya.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
889.e: Any humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
will have all his hopes fulfilled. ||3||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the anchor and support of the Lord's devotees.
The Saints are victorious in this priceless human life.
Whatever the Lord's Saint does, is approved and accepted.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||4||11||22||
Chaupaee

889.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਆਵੈ ॥

889.e: ‘In whose sight the deer came, he should put his horse behind,

889.g: ਕੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਰੈ, ਕੈ ਗਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
ਯੌ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੌ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਹਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੬॥
889.e: ‘Either he should kill the deer or should never came back to’ show me his face.(6)
With the grace of God, a deer came to confront the royal prince.
Then Sumat Singh ran his horse and chased the deer.(7)

890.e: Chaupaee
The false was turned into truth and no body could detect the reality.
Taking him with her, she left for the country of Siam and saved him from the sharp edge of the sword.(27)

890.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੋ ਬਚਨ ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਧਾਏ ॥

890.e: Immediately getting Raja’s order, the attendants came to the daughter of the minister.
‘What country have you come and whose son are you? Come our Raja has called you.’(17)
Dohira

890.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਨੀ; ਸੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਤੁਯ ਦੇਵ ॥
890.e: ‘Whatever narration I have heard, I have related to you.

890.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਿਯੋ; ਕਿਸੂ ਨ ਦੀਜਹੁ ਭੇਵ ॥੨੪॥
890.e: ‘Now you keep this in your heart and please never divulge.’(24)

890.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਬਚਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਤਿਹ ਲੀਨ ॥
890.e: Listening to the talk he called him near him,

890.g: ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਸਾਹ ਕੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਲਖਿ ਤੁਰਤ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੫॥
890.e: And, immediately recognising, he bade to release the son of Siam.(25)

890.g: ਦੁਹਿਤਾ ਦਈ ਵਜੀਰ ਕੀ; ਹੈ ਗੈ ਦਏ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
890.e: Along with the daughter of the minister, he gave him many elephants and horses.

890.g: ਪਤਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਛਲਿ ਕੈ ਤੁਰਤ; ਬਾਰ ਨ ਬਾਕਯੋ ਏਕ ॥੨੬॥
890.e: Through an Chritar, that damsel made him as her husband, and did not let him any harm.(26)
Dohira

890.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਿਵਜੂ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਸੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
890.e: ‘Oh, my Raja, whatever Shiva told me, I have communicated to you.
Dohira

890.g: ਕੌਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤੈ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਆਯੋ ਇਹ ਦੇਸ ॥
890.e: ‘You are the son of which Raja and why have you come here?

890.g: ਕ︀ਯੋ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਘੋਰਾ ਚਰਿਯੋ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਅਸਿਤ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਭੇਸ ॥੧੮॥
890.e: ‘Why are you riding on such a grand horse and why are you dressed in black?’(18)
Chaupaee
The women of the South are unique.
Even ascetics are turned into householders in their association.
There used to be a ruler of Chandra Bansi Clan, named Chatter Singh.(1)

890.g: ਹੈ ਗੈ ਰਥ ਪੈਦਲ ਬਹੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
ਔਰ ਭੂਪ ਕੋਊ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
890.e: He had numerous elephants, horses and foot soldiers, and no other ruler was of his standing.

890.g: ਰੂਪ ਕਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਕੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
890.e: Roop Kala was his wife, who appeared to be born of the Cupid’s wedlock.(2)

890.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਰਾਵ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
ਜੋ ਵਹੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹੈ, ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
890.e: A number of Rajas were under his suzerainty.

890.g: ਰੂਪ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਹ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਡਰੈ ॥

890.e: But Roop Kala never feared him and she acted whatever the way she willed.(3)
Dohira

890.g: ਇਕ ਦਿਨ ਬੈਠੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਨ ਮੈ; ਹੋਡ ਪਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
890.e: One day the women were gathered, and a bet was eventuated,

890.g: ਪਿਯ ਦੇਖਤ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਰ ਸੋ; ਭੋਗ ਸਕਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
890.e: Who could make love with her paramour while husband was watching.(4)
In the third stage of life, he gathers the wealth of Maya.
And when he grows old, he must leave all this; he departs regretting and repenting. ||2||
After a very long time, one obtains this precious human body, so difficult to obtain.
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it is reduced to dust.
Worse than a beast, a demon or an idiot,

890.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਸਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
890.e: is that one who does not understand who created him. ||3||
Listen, O Creator Lord, Lord of the Universe, Lord of the World,
Merciful to the meek, forever compassionate
If You emancipate the human, then his bonds are broken.
O Nanak, the people of world are blind; please, Lord, forgive them, and unite them with Yourself. ||4||12||23||
Chhape Chhand

890.g: ਨ ਹੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ; ਨ ਹੈ ਦੇਸਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਈ ॥
890.e: ‘Neither I am the son of a Raja, nor I am the ruler.

890.g: ਤਵ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੁਤਾ; ਲਖਨ ਕੌਤਕ ਕੌ ਆਈ ॥
890.e: I have come to see the daughter of your minister.

890.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
890.e: ‘In the Shastras and Simritis, basic truths are narrated,

890.g: ਤਤੁ ਲਖਨ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ; ਮੋਰ ਹਿਯਰਾ ਉਮਗਾਯੋ ॥
890.e: ‘I have come to understand the gist of those.

890.g: ਤਬੈ ਉਚਰਿਹੌ ਬੈਨ; ਜਬੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਨ ਸੋ ਲਹਿਹੋ ॥
890.e: ‘When I have observed those with my own eyes, I will communicate with you

890.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਲਹੇ; ਭੇਦ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ, ਤੁਮੈ ਨ ਕਹਿਹੋ ॥੧੯॥
890.e: ‘Without seeing them I cannot adjudge.’(l9)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Millions of meditations and austerities rest in him,
along with wealth, wisdom, miraculous spiritual powers and angelic spiritual insight.
He enjoys the various shows and forms, pleasures and delicacies;
the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the heart of the Gurmukh. ||1||
Such is the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord.
Its value cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
He alone is brave, patient and perfectly wise;
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

890.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
890.e: Whatever He does makes me happy.
The ignorant mind is encouraged, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Now, it does not waver at all; it has become stable and steady.
Receiving Truth, it is merged in the True Lord. ||1||
Pain is gone, and all illness is gone.

890.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ; ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
890.e: I have accepted the Will of God in my mind, associating with the Great Person, the Guru. ||1||Pause||
All is pure; all is immaculate.
Whatever exists is good.
Wherever He keeps me, that is the place of liberation for me.
Whatever He makes me chant, is His Name. ||2||

890.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ; ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
890.e: That is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the Holy place their feet,
and that is heaven, where the Naam is chanted.
All bliss comes, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

890.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
890.e: I sing continuously, continually, the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
The Lord Himself is pervading in each and every heart.
The glory of the Merciful Lord is radiant and manifest.
The shutters are opened, and doubts have run away.
Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru. ||4||14||25||
Dohira

890.g: ਅਤਿਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾਨ ਕੀ; ਜਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਕੋਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
890.e: The accomplishments of the women are such that no one can acquiesce.

890.g: ਭੇਦ ਹਾਥ ਆਵੈ ਨਹੀ; ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕਿਯੇ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੨੮॥
890.e: In spite of numerous endeavours, one cannot understand their enigma.(28)(I)

890.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਛਿਆਸਠਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬੬॥੧੧੭੨॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
890.e: Sixty-sixth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (66)(1170)
Dohira

890.g: ਸੁਨ ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਮੈ ਕਹੋਂ ਕਿਸੂ ਨ ਦੀਜਹੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
890.e: ‘Listen, my Raja, what ever I relate to you, don’t disclose to any body.

890.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਹਤ; ਔਰ ਉਚਾਰਤ ਬੇਦ ॥੨੧॥
890.e: ‘I will tell you what ever is written in Shastras and Simritis.(21)

890.g: ਜਹਾ ਸਾਧ ਕਹ ਚੋਰ ਕਰਿ; ਮਾਰਤ ਲੋਗ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
890.e: ‘The land where people label saints as thief and kill them,

890.g: ਤੁਰਤ ਧਰਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਠੌਰ ਕੀ; ਧਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
890.e: ‘That land soon goes down under (devastation).’(22)
Chaupaee

890.g: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਤਿਹ ਠਾ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
890.e: The Rani kept this indication in her heart; she did not raise her voice.
When a couple of months had passed, she came and told the Raja, (5)

890.g: ਸੁਨੁ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਮੈ ਸਿਵ ਪੂਜਨ ਗਈ ॥

890.e: ‘Listen my Raja, I had gone to prey for Shiva and I was endowed with celestial utterance.

890.g: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਹੈ ॥੬॥
890.e: ‘It said, “Who-so-ever comes here, every body, will indulge with him in sex-play.”(6)
Chaupaee
Raja said, ‘Reveal the secret to me and don’t hesitate at all.

890.g: ਭੇਦ ਔਰ ਤਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਭਾਖੋ ॥੨੦॥
890.e: ‘Whatever you tell me, I will preserve it in my heart and will not betray.’(20)
Chaupaee
‘The way it is expressed in Shastras and Simritis, I have come to discern that.

890.g: ਦੇਖੋ ਕਹਾ ਇਹ ਠਾ ਅਬ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
ਫਟਿ ਹੈ ਧਰਨਿ ਕਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਫਟਿ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥੨੩॥
890.e: ‘Now we will see whether the earth goes down or not.(23)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Joining the elements together, the robe of the body is fashioned.
The ignorant fool is engrossed in it.
He cherishes it, and constantly takes care of it.
But at the very last moment, he must arise and depart. ||1||
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is false, O mortal.

890.g: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
890.e: Those who do not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, but instead are imbued with other things, - all those mortals are plundered by Maya. ||1||Pause||
Bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, filth is not washed off.
Religious rituals are all just egotistical displays.
By pleasing and appeasing people, no one is saved.
Without the Naam, they shall depart weeping. ||2||

890.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਨ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਪਟਲ ॥
890.e: Without the Lord's Name, the screen is not torn away.
I have studied all the Shaastras and Simritees.

890.g: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
890.e: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord Himself inspires to chant.
He obtains all fruits and rewards, and merges in peace. ||3||
O Savior Lord, please save me!
All peace and comforts are in Your Hand, God.
Whatever you attach me to, to that I am attached, O my Lord and Master.
O Nanak, the Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||13||24||

891.e: Chaupaee

891.g: ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸਿਵ ਬੈਨ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥

891.e: Be thought, ‘Whatever Shiva predicted, is being proved true in my own house.

891.g: ਰੂਪ ਮਤੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਕਹਿਯੋ ॥
ਅਬ ਸੋ ਸਾਚ ਤਵਨ ਕੋ ਲਹਿਯੋ ॥੧੨॥
891.e: ‘Roop Kala was after all not telling lies. I have recognised her truthfulness now.’(12)

891.g: ਚਿਤ ਅਪਨੇ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਿਯਹੁ; ਕਿਸੂ ਨ ਦੀਜਹੁ ਭੇਵ ॥੭॥
891.e: ‘Please keep it in your heart and do not reveal to any body.’(7)

891.g: ਐਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੋ ਭਾਖਿ ਕੈ; ਦਿਨ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਤਾਇ ॥
891.e: After, when about four days had passed, she expressed,

891.g: ਸਕਲ ਕੋਠਰਿਨ ਤੇ ਲਏ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਾਰ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥੮॥
891.e: That all his lovers should come out of their houses.(8)

891.g: ਆਪਨ ਸੋ ਲੌਡਿਯਨ ਸੋਂ ਜਾਰ ਦਏ ਚਿਮਟਾਇ ॥
891.e: She assembled all her maids and their friends,

891.g: ਪਠੈ ਏਕ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਈ; ਕਹੌ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
891.e: And, then she sent a maid to tell the Raja.(9)
Dohira

891.g: ਅਸ੍ਵ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਪਨੇ; ਤਨਕਿਕ ਮੋ ਕੋ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
891.e: ‘You give me your horse and all your clothes,

891.g: ਯਹ ਬੁਗਚਾ ਤੁਮ ਲੈ ਚਲੌ; ਚਲਿ ਆਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
891.e: ‘And taking this bundle you walk in front of me.’(5)
Chaupaee

891.g: ਤਾ ਕੌ ਬੁਗਚਾ ਨਿਜੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਯੋ ॥
891.e: The son of Shah acted as told and put the bundle over his head.
He (Shah’s son) made him to ride his horse and put on him (barber’s Son) his clothes.(6)
Dohira

891.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਏਕ ਗੁਜਰਾਤ ਕੋ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਇਕ ਪੂਤ ॥
891.e: There lived a Shah in Gujarat, who had a son.

891.g: ਸੌਦਾ ਕੌ ਚੌਕਸ ਕਰੈ; ਪਿਤੁ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਸਪੂਤ ॥੧॥
891.e: He was an obedient boy and was very alert in business.(1)

891.g: ਨਾਊ ਕੇ ਇਕ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਪ︀ਯਾਰ ॥
891.e: He esteemed the son of a barber,

891.g: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਊ ਏਕਸੋ; ਕੋਊ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
891.e: And they looked alike so much that no one could distinguish.(2)
Dohira

891.g: ਤੁਰਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਗਯੋ; ਕੇਲ ਕਰਤ ਜਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਯ ॥
891.e: On learning this, Raja immediately reached there where the ladies were making-love.

891.g: ਸਿਵ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਠਟਕਿ ਰਹਤ ਭਯੋ ਜੀਯ ॥੧੧॥
891.e: Observing the utterances of Shiva coming true, he was astounded.(11)
Dohira

891.g: ਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਨ; ਦੀਨੇ ਜਾਰ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
891.e: After making love all the woman were sent away,

891.g: ਆਪੁ ਆਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੋ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਬਹਿਗੀ ਬਾਤ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
891.e: And Rani herself came and sat near the Raja.(13)

891.g: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ, ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਬਾਤ ਅਬ ਵਹੈ ਲਹੀ ॥
891.e: ‘My Raja, as I told you, it did transpire that way.

891.g: ਕੋਪ ਨ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਕੀਜਿਯਹੁ; ਸਿਵ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਹੀ ॥੧੪॥
891.e: ‘And now never get angry at Shiva, because his utterances are true.’(l4)

891.g: ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਗਨ; ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ॥
891.e: Kinnar, Jachh, Bhujang, Gann, Humans and Ascetics, all types of gods,

891.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ; ਰੰਚ ਨ ਚੀਨਤ ਭੇਵ ॥੧੫॥
891.e: Could not understand the Chritars of the female.(15)(1)

891.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਸਤਾਸਠਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬੭॥੧੧੮੭॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
891.e: Sixty-seventh Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (67)(1185)
he is intuitively in Samaadhi, profound and unfathomable.

891.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
891.e: He is liberated forever and all his affairs are perfectly resolved;

891.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
891.e: the Lord's Name abides within his heart. ||2||
He is totally peaceful, blissful and healthy;
he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.

891.g: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
891.e: He does not come and go, and he never wavers;

891.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
891.e: the Naam abides in his mind. ||3||
God is Merciful to the meek; He is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.
The Gurmukh meditates on Him, and his worries are gone.
The Guru has blessed Nanak with the Naam;

891.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
891.e: he serves the Saints, and works for the Saints. ||4||15||26||
Chaupaee
Shah’s son took barber’s son with him to his in-laws.
When they were passing through the thick jungle, the barber’s son called him.(3)
Barber’s son said, ‘Listen, you the son of Shah,
‘I accept your friendship only if you do me a favour.(4)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

891.g: ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ; ਨ ਆਈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
891.e: No matter how hard you try to grab it, it does not come into your hands.
No matter how much you may love it, it does not go along with you.
Says Nanak, when you abandon it,
then it comes and falls at your feet. ||1||
Listen, O Saints: this is the pure philosophy.

891.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.e: Without the Lord's Name, there is no salvation. Meeting with the Perfect Guru, one is saved. ||1||Pause||
Chaupaee

891.g: ਜੁ ਮੈ ਤੁਮੈ ਸਿਵ ਬਾਨੀ ਕਹੀ ॥
891.e: ‘What I told you about Shiva’s utterances,
‘I have seen that happening in your house.
‘Now leaving the Shastras come with me, and please don’t get angry.’(10)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra.
Even the homeless find a home in the world hereafter.
Fall at the feet of the Perfect Guru;
you have slept for so many incarnations - wake up! ||1||
Chant the Chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

891.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.e: By Guru's Grace, it shall be enshrined within your heart, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the eternal treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mind,
and then, the screen of Maya shall be torn away.

891.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
891.e: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Shabad,
and then your soul shall be rendered immaculate and pure. ||2||
Searching, searching, searching, I have realized
that without devotional worship of the Lord, no one is saved.

891.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ; ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
891.e: So vibrate, and meditate on that Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

891.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
891.e: your mind and body shall be imbued with love for the Lord. ||3||
Renounce all your cleverness and trickery.

891.g: ਮਨ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ; ਜਾਇ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
891.e: O mind, without the Lord's Name, there is no place of rest.
The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World, has taken pity on me.
Nanak seeks the protection and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||16||27||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

891.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
891.e: In the Saints' Congregation, play joyfully with the Lord,

891.g: ਆਗੈ; ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ. ਮੇਲ ॥
891.e: and you will not have to meet the Messenger of Death hereafter.
Your egotistical intellect shall be dispelled,
and your evil-mindedness will be totally taken away. ||1||
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Pandit.

891.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ. ਨ ਕਾਜੈ; ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.e: Religious rituals and egotism are of no use at all. You shall go home with happiness, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

891.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਧਿ; ਲੀਆ ਲਾਭ ॥
891.e: I have earned the profit, the wealth of the Lord's praise.
All my hopes have been fulfilled.

891.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ; ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
891.e: Pain has left me, and peace has come to my home.
By the Grace of the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
One who is blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Name,
obtains all treasures.
His mind becomes content, finding the Perfect Lord.
Why should he ever go begging again? ||3||
Hearing the Lord's sermon, he becomes pure and holy.
Chanting it with his tongue, he finds the way to salvation.
He alone is approved, who enshrines the Lord within his heart.
Nanak: such a humble being is exalted, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||17||28||

892.e: Dohira

892.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਛੇਰੀ ਲਏ; ਬਨ ਮੈ ਭਯੋ ਖਰਾਬ ॥
892.e: Thus the Shah’s son roamed around in the jungle,

892.g: ਸੂਕਿ ਦੂਬਰੋ ਤਨ ਭਯੋ; ਹੇਰੇ ਲਜਤ ਰਬਾਬ ॥੧੩॥
892.e: And got weaker and weaker with the shame.(13)
Chaupaee
The Shah’s son asked, ‘Please do me a favour.
‘Give him a few goats. He will take them out for grazing and will come back in the evening.’(12)
The barber’s son disguised himself and giving him his bundle made him to walk.

892.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਹਰਖਾਨੋ ॥
ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੭॥
892.e: He felt very happy but the Shah’s son could not understand the secret.(7)
Dohira

892.g: ਖਾਟ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਦੁਖ︀ਯ ਭਯੋ ਚਿਤ ॥
892.e: Taking the bed Shah’s son was very much afflicted.

892.g: ਗਹਿਰੇ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਰੋਵਤ ਪੀਟਤ ਨਿਤ ॥੧੫॥
892.e: And every day went to the jungle to cry and wallop himself.(15)

892.g: ਮਹਾ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ; ਜਾਤ ਹੁਤੈ ਨਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
892.e: Once (god) Shiva and (his consort) Parvatti were passing-by there.

892.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕੈ; ਦਯਾ ਭਈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
892.e: Watching him in agony, they took pity on him.(16)
Chaupaee
They acknowledged the Shah’s son as the barber’s son and the barber’s son as the Shah’s.

892.g: ਅਤਿ ਲਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਵਹੁ ਰਹਿਯੋ ॥
ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਬਚਨ ਨਹਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
892.e: He was very much ashamed but he could not say any thing to contradict.(10)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
See the Lord, the Universal Soul, in all.
The One God is perfect, and all-pervading.
Know that the priceless jewel is within your own heart.
Realize that your essence is within your own self. ||1||
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, by the Grace of the Saints.

892.g: ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ. ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.e: One who is blessed with high destiny, obtains it. Without a tongue, how can one know the taste? ||1||Pause||

892.g: ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ; ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
892.e: How can a deaf person listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the Vedas?
The blind man cannot see even a million lights.
The beast loves grass, and remains attached to it.

892.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
892.e: One who has not been taught - how can he understand? ||2||
God, the Knower, knows all.
He is with His devotees, through and through.
Those who sing God's Praises with joy and delight,

892.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੩॥੧੯॥੩੦॥
892.e: O Nanak - the Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||3||19||30||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Blessing me with His Name, He has purified and sanctified me.

892.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ; ਨਿਰਾਸ ਇਹ ਬਿਤੁ ॥
892.e: The Lord's wealth is my capital. False hope has left me; this is my wealth.
Breaking my bonds, the Lord has linked me to His service.

892.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
892.e: I am a devotee of the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds.

892.g: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.e: The Lord's humble servants sing His Glorious Praises with love and delight; they are honored by the Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||
My pre-ordained destiny has been activated;
I have awakened from the sleep of countless incarnations.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my aversion is gone.

892.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
892.e: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord. ||2||
The Merciful Savior Lord has saved me.

892.g: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ; ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
892.e: I have no service or work to my credit.
In His Mercy, God has taken pity on me;
He lifted me up and pulled me out, when I was suffering in pain. ||3||

892.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
892.e: Listening, listening to His Praises, joy has welled up within my mind.

892.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
892.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Singing, singing His Praises, I have obtained the supreme status.
By Guru's Grace, Nanak is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||4||20||31||
Chaupaee

892.g: ਜਬੈ ਚਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਕਹੈ ॥

892.e: Now whenever he said, get stuck, it (goat) would lie down.

892.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਬਚਨ ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਜਬ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਤਬ ਤਿਹ ਚਿਤ ਯਹ ਠਾਟ ਠਟ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੧੯॥
892.e: As Shiva’s words were coming true, he decided to play this trick.(19)

892.g: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ. ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
892.e: When someone tries to appease her,
then she takes pride in herself.

892.g: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ. ਕੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
892.e: But when someone puts her out of his thoughts,
then she serves him like a slave. ||2||
She seems to please, but in the end, she deceives.

892.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਠਉਰ; ਓਹ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
892.e: She does not remain in any one place.
She has bewitched a great many worlds.
The Lord's humble servants cut her apart into pieces. ||3||
Whoever begs from her remains hungry.

892.g: ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ; ਸੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
892.e: Whoever is infatuated with her obtains nothing.
But one who renounces her, and joins the Society of the Saints,
by great good fortune, O Nanak, is saved. ||4||18||29||
Dohira

892.g: ਨਊਆ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੀ; ਦੀਨੀ ਬਧੂ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
892.e: The Shah’s son was received as the barber’s son,

892.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਯੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਦੁਆਰੇ ਬੈਠਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
892.e: And the Shah’s son was told to go and sit out side on the door step.(11)
Chaupaee
Being compassionate they said, ‘Listen, you, the distressed son of the Shah,

892.g: ਜਾਇ ਚਮਰੁ ਤੂ, ਤੂ ਮੁਖ ਕਹਿ ਹੈ ॥
ਛੇਰੀ ਲਗੀ ਭੂੰਮ ਮੈ ਰਹਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੭॥
892.e: ‘Which ever the goat you would order to get stuck, that will go to sleep.(17)
Chaupaee
When he saw him getting very week, the barber’s son asked,

892.g: ਏਕ ਖਾਟ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਦੀਜੈ ॥

892.e: ‘Give him a bed, and every body must do what I say.’(14)
Dohira

892.g: ਜਬੈ ਉਝਰੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਖਿ ਹੈ; ਤੁਰਤ ਵਹੈ ਛੁਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
892.e: ‘And whenever you would say, get up,

892.g: ਜਬ ਲਗਿਯੋ ਕਹਿ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ; ਮਰੈ ਧਰਨਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
892.e: The goat will get up and would not be dead.’(8)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
In exchange for a shell, he gives up a jewel.
He tries to get what he must give up.
He collects those things which are worthless.
Enticed by Maya, he takes the crooked path. ||1||
You unfortunate man - have you no shame?

892.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.e: You do not remember in your mind the ocean of peace, the perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Nectar seems bitter to you, and poison is sweet.
Such is your condition, you faithless cynic, which I have seen with my own eyes.
You are fond of falsehood, fraud and egotism.
Dohira

892.g: ਚਲਤ ਚਲਤ ਸਸੁਰਾਰਿ ਕੌ ਗਾਵ ਪਹੂੰਚ︀ਯੋ ਆਇ ॥
892.e: Walking and walking they reached the village of the in-laws.

892.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਨ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੋ; ਹੈ ਪਰ ਲਿਯੋ ਚਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
892.e: But he did not dismount and did not let him (the Shah’s son) to mount.(8)

892.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਹ ਕਹਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ; ਲਯੋ ਨ ਤੁਰੈ ਚਰਾਇ ॥
892.e: The Shah’s son insisted but he did not let him ride the horse.

892.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਲਖਿ ਤਿਹ ਧਨੀ; ਸਕਲ ਮਿਲਤ ਭੇ ਆਇ ॥੯॥
892.e: (People) came and met assuming the barber’s son to be the Shah’s son.(9)

893.e: Dohira

893.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਦੁਖੀ ਪੁਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
893.e: Whole populace was in turmoil but they were helpless to do anything.

893.g: ਚਲਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਖਿ; ਰਹੇ ਚਰਨ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥੩੨॥
893.e: Seeing them walking in, they fell on their feet (and begged),(32)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name.
Hereafter, I shall obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.
I am in bliss forever; I have no sorrow.
The disease of ego never afflicts me. ||1||
O Saints of the Lord, seek out those who know God.

893.g: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ, ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
893.e: You shall be wonderstruck with wonder at the wonderful Lord; meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal, and obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
Calculating, measuring, and thinking in every way,

893.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ. ਤਾਰਿ ॥
893.e: see that without the Naam, no one can be carried across.
Of all your efforts, none will go along with you.
You can cross over the terrifying world-ocean only through the love of God. ||2||
By merely washing the body, one's filth is not removed.
Afflicted by egotism, duality only increases.

893.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
893.e: That humble being who takes the medicine of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

893.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ; ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
893.e: - all his diseases are eradicated. ||3||
Take pity on me, O merciful, Supreme Lord God;

893.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
893.e: let me never forget the Lord of the World from my mind.
Let me be the dust of the feet of Your slaves;
O God, please fulfill Nanak's hope. ||4||22||33||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
You are my Protection, O perfect Divine Guru.
There is no other than You.
You are all-powerful, O perfect Supreme Lord God.
He alone meditates on You, whose karma is perfect. ||1||
You Name, God, is the boat to carry us across.

893.g: ਏਕਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ. ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
893.e: My mind has grasped Your protection alone. Other than You, I have no place of rest at all. ||1||Pause||
Chanting, meditating on Your Name, I live,
and hereafter, I will obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.
Pain and darkness are gone from my mind;
my evil-mindedness is dispelled, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||
I have enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.
The lifestyle of the Perfect Guru is immaculate and pure.
My fear has run away, and the fearless Lord dwells within my mind.
My tongue continually chants the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
The nooses of millions of incarnations are cut away.
I have obtained the profit of the true wealth.
This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never run out.
O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||23||34||
Chaupaee
The Shah’s son suggested, ‘Dear Hakim, listen to me, my remedy,
‘Previously I suffered as well and through this it was remedied.’(28)
Dohira

893.g: ਯਾ ਘੋਰੀ ਕੇ ਭਗ ਬਿਖੈ; ਜੀਭ ਦਈ ਸੌ ਬਾਰ ॥
893.e: ‘I had thrust my tongue in the vagina of the mare for a hundred times,

893.g: ਤੁਰਤ ਰੋਗ ਹਮਰੋ ਕਟਿਯੋ; ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੈਦ, ਉਪਚਾਰ ॥੨੯॥
893.e: ‘Then, listen hakim, my curse was eliminated immediately.’(29)
Chaupaee

893.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤਬਹ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਆਯੋ ॥

893.e: The Shah’s son came there and told him what had happened.

893.g: ਜੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੋ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਜ ਕਮਾਊ ॥

893.e: (He said,) ‘I will act the way you tell me and I will go and get a hakim (lay doctor).’(23)

893.g: ਖੋਜਿ ਬੈਦ ਕੋ ਸੰਗ ਲੈ ਆਯੋ ॥
893.e: The Shah’s son rode a mare to go in search, and to request the hakim to come.
He (barber’s son) felt to go to meet the call of the nature, after handing over the mare to the son ofthe Shah.(24)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby.
It brings Truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
The Lord entrusts the treasures of peace,
Intuition and kindness to His devotees. ||1||
This is the treasure of my Lord.

893.g: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਿ ਕਛੁ ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
893.e: Consuming and expending it, it is never used up. The Lord has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||
The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a priceless diamond.
It is the ocean of bliss and virtue.
In the Word of the Guru's Bani is the wealth of the unstruck sound current.
The Saints hold the key to it in their hands. ||2||
Chaupaee
‘Please promote some resolve, and considering us all as your own subject, save us.
Dohira

893.g: ਜਾਇ ਬੂਟੈ ਤਬ ਬੈਠਿਯੋ; ਲਈ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
893.e: Undoing his lion-cloth he postured to relieve himself.

893.g: ਡਲਾ ਭਏ ਪੌਛਨ ਲਗਿਯੋ; ਕਹਿਯੋ ਚਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੨੫॥
893.e: As soon as he picked up and used a stone (to wipe off), he (Shah’s Son), pronounced, ‘get stuck.’

893.g: ਹਾਥ ਲਗੋਟੀ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ; ਡਲਾ ਫਸਿਯੋ ਬੁਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
893.e: The corner of the lion-cloth remained in his (barber’s son’s) hand

893.g: ਚਰਨ ਝਾਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਰਸੇ; ਤਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨੬॥
893.e: And the stone was stuck in his rectum His feet were clung in the rope and he lost all his consciousness.(26)

893.g: ਲਏ ਅਸ੍ਵਨੀ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤ ਪਹੂੰਚ︀ਯੋ ਆਇ ॥
893.e: When the Shah’s son brought hakim on a mare,

893.g: ਕਹਿਯੋ ਬੈਦ ਮੈ ਕ︀ਯਾ ਕਰੋਂ ਇਹ ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੨੭॥
893.e: He asked, ‘Oh, hakim, how can I remedy this adversity.’(27)
Chaupaee

893.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਭਗ ਮੈ ਜੀਭ ਧਸਾਈ ॥
893.e: The hakim wanted to try by himself, and thrust his tongue in the mare’s vagma.

893.g: ਕਹਿਯੋ ਚਮਰੁ ਤੂ, ਸੋ ਲਗਿ ਗਈ ॥

893.e: He (Shah’s son) announced, get stuck, it was caught there and a great funwas ensued.(30)

893.g: ਲਏ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪੁਰ ਆਯੋ ॥

893.e: He (Shah’s son) brought them to display in the village (where all people were already stuck).

893.g: ਇਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਛੁਟਨ ਤੇ ਡਰੌ ॥੩੧॥
893.e: Every body requested hakim, ‘Please imply some antidote to release us.’(31)
If you hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you feel like you have been stung by a scorpion. ||2||
You continually yearn for Maya,

893.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ; ਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
893.e: and you never chant the Lord's Praises with your mouth.
The Lord is fearless and formless; He is the Great Giver.

893.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਨ ਕਰੈ. ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
893.e: But you do not love Him, you fool! ||3||
God, the True King, is above the heads of all kings.
He is the independent, perfect Lord King.
People are intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in doubt and family life.
Nanak: they are saved only by Your Mercy, Lord. ||4||21||32||
Dohira

893.g: ਸਭੈ ਚਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਬਿਨਾ; ਯਾ ਪੁਰ ਮੈ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
893.e: He pronounced, ‘Except me every body get stuck.’

893.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਹੁਤੀ; ਲਗੀ ਰਹੀ ਛਿਤ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੦॥
893.e: Then all the men and women, where ever they were, they plunged on the ground.(20)

893.g: ਸੋਤ ਜਗਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ; ਚਿਮਟ ਗਏ ਛਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
893.e: All those who were sleeping, awake, standing or sitting got stuck with the ground.

893.g: ਕੂਕ ਉਠੀ ਪੁਰ ਮੈ ਘਨੀ; ਨੈਕ ਰਹੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨੧॥
893.e: No one remained in his senses and lamentations were prevailing all over.(21)

893.g: ਪਤਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਾਧਿਤ ਫਸਿਯੋ; ਪਾਕ ਪਕਾਵਤ ਤ੍ਰੀਯ ॥
893.e: Husband was stuck while tying his lion-cloth and the woman was stuck while cooking.

893.g: ਨੌਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸੋਵਤ ਫਸਿਯੋ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਜੀਯ ॥੨੨॥
893.e: The husband sleeping with newly wed was stuck and no one remained rational.(22)

894.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
I have not tried to do anything through knowledge.
I have no knowledge, intelligence or spiritual wisdom.
I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, humility or righteousness.
I know nothing of such good karma. ||1||
O my Beloved God, my Lord and Master,

894.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਭੂਲਹ ਚੂਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
894.e: there is none other than You. Even though I wander and make mistakes, I am still Yours, God. ||1||Pause||

894.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ; ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
894.e: I have no wealth, no intelligence, no miraculous spiritual powers; I am not enlightened.

894.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੇ ਗਾਵ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
894.e: I dwell in the village of corruption and sickness.
O my One Creator Lord God,

894.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
894.e: Your Name is the support of my mind. ||2||

894.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਉ; ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
894.e: Hearing, hearing Your Name, I live; this is my mind's consolation.
Your Name, God, is the Destroyer of sins.
You, O Limitless Lord, are the Giver of the soul.
He alone knows You, unto whom You reveal Yourself. ||3||
Whoever has been created, rests his hopes in You.
All worship and adore You, God, O treasure of excellence.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You.
My merciful Lord and Master is infinite. ||4||26||37||
Dohira

894.g: ਚਪਲ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਡੋ; ਰਾਜ ਕਲਾ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
894.e: There was once a great Raja and Raj Kala was his wife.

894.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵ ਰੀਝੇ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਅਨੁਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
894.e: There was none like her; even, the god Indra fancied her.(l)

894.g: ਸੋ ਰਾਨੀ ਇਕ ਚੋਰ ਸੋ ਰਮ︀ਯੋ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ॥
894.e: That Rani, day in and day out, used to make love with a thief.

894.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਨਿਜੁ ਸਦਨ; ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਹ ਐਨ ॥੨॥
894.e: She used to call him at her house, and, herself, often went to his residence as well.(2)

894.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਵਤ ਸਦਨ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ ਲਖਿਯੋ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
894.e: One day Raja, when he was proceeding to her house, he saw him.

894.g: ਲੂਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਲਯੋ; ਸੂਰੀ ਦਿਯੋ ਚਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
894.e: He beat the thief severely and ordered him to be hanged.(3)

894.g: ਜਬ ਸ੍ਰੋਨਤ ਭਭਕੋ ਉਠਤ; ਤਬ ਆਖੈ ਖੁਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
894.e: Whenever the pain pinched him, he regained awareness.

894.g: ਜਬੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਤਰ ਕੋ ਰਮੈ; ਕਛੂ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
894.e: But after a few breaths he would become unconscious again.(4)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
The Vedas do not know His greatness.
Brahma does not know His mystery.
Incarnated beings do not know His limit.
The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is infinite. ||1||
Only He Himself knows His own state.
Others speak of Him only by hearsay. ||1||Pause||
Shiva does not know His mystery.
The gods gave grown weary of searching for Him.
The goddesses do not know His mystery.
Above all is the unseen, Supreme Lord God. ||2||
The Creator Lord plays His own plays.
He Himself separates, and He Himself unites.
Some wander around, while others are linked to His devotional worship.
By His actions, He makes Himself known. ||3||
Listen to the true story of the Saints.
They speak only of what they see with their eyes.

894.g: ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ॥
894.e: He is not involved with virtue or vice.
Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. ||4||25||36||
Chaupaee
Then he narrated the entire story, which people listened attentively.
They gave him another damsel and praised him in various ways.(34)
Then the Shah’s son emancipated the whole village.

894.g: ਨਿਜੁ ਪੁਰ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਰੋ ਮਗੁ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੩੫॥
894.e: He married second time and took the way to his village.(35)(1)

894.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਅਠਾਸਠਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬੮॥੧੨੨੨॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
894.e: Sixty-eighth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (68)(1220)
Dohira

894.g: ਜਬ ਤਸਕਰ ਚੁੰਬਨ ਕਰਿਯੋ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥
894.e: Immediately after taking the kiss, his soul departed for heavens.

894.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟਿਯੋ ਮੁਖ ਮੈ ਰਹਿਯੋ; ਰਾਨੀ ਭਈ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥੯॥
894.e: The cut (piece) of the (Rani’s) nose remained in his mouth, and the Rani became desperate.(9)
Chaupaee
When the Rani heard this she immediately ran out to see him.
When the blood spurted out and h~ regained consciousness, he saw the woman.(5)
Then she said, ‘Listen thief, I say it you with love,

894.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਆਗ︀ਯਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁ ਕਰੋ ॥

894.e: ‘That I could not live. Without you, I will kill myself.’(6)
Then the thief spoke, ‘I have a desire in my heart,
‘That I may kiss you and then go up for hanging.’(7)
When Rani kissed him, a stream of blood gushed out of the nose.

894.g: ਤਬ ਤਸਕਰ ਕੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਰਿ ਗਯੋ ॥

894.e: The thief’s mouth shut (with force) and the Rani’s nose was cut.(8)
Chaupaee
With the nose cut, the woman came home.

894.g: ਸੋ ਨਹਿ ਲਗ︀ਯੋ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਯੌ ਭਾਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
894.e: She told the Raja that, ‘I cut my nose to present to (Lord) Shiva, because it pleased (Lord) Shiva immensely.’
‘But Shiva Jee spoke thus, “Your nose has been put in the mouth of a thief.”
They sit there, in the cave of deep Samaadhi;
the unique, perfect Lord God dwells there.
God holds conversations with His devotees.

894.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਸੋਗ; ਨ ਜਨਮ. ਨ ਮਰਤ ॥੩॥
894.e: There is no pleasure or pain, no birth or death there. ||3||
One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy,
obtains the Lord's wealth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Nanak prays to the merciful Primal Lord;

894.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੫॥
894.e: the Lord is my merchandise, and the Lord is my capital. ||4||24||35||
‘All our people have committed some mistakes, but now please save us from this heinous malady.’(33)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
The Savior Lord is merciful.
Millions of incarnations are eradicated in an instant, contemplating the Lord.
All beings worship and adore Him.
Receiving the Guru's Mantra, one meets God. ||1||
My God is the Giver of souls.

894.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
894.e: The Perfect Transcendent Lord Master, my God, imbues each and every heart. ||1||Pause||
My mind has grasped His Support.
My bonds have been shattered.
Within my heart, I meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
My mind is filled with ecstasy. ||2||
The Lord's Sanctuary is the boat to carry us across.
The Lord's Feet are the embodiment of life itself.

895.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Whatever happens, accept that as good.
Leave your egotistical pride behind.
Day and night, continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
This is the perfect purpose of human life. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord, O Saints, and be in bliss.

895.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
895.e: Renounce your cleverness and all your tricks. Chant the Immaculate Chant of the Guru's Mantra. ||1||Pause||
Place the hopes of your mind in the One Lord.
Chant the Immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Bow down to the Guru's Feet,
and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
The Lord God is the Great Giver.
He has no end or limitation.
All treasures are in His home.
He will be your Saving Grace in the end. ||3||
Nanak has obtained this treasure,
the immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

895.g: ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
895.e: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
It is obtained only by His Grace. ||4||29||40||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Make this invaluable human life fruitful.
You shall not be destroyed when you go to the Lord's Court.
In this world and the next, you shall obtain honor and glory.
At the very last moment, He will save you. ||1||
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

895.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਅਚਰਜ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
895.e: In both this world and the next, you shall be embellished with beauty, meditating on the wondrous Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||
While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord,
and all your troubles shall depart.
All your enemies will become friends.
Your consciousness shall be immaculate and pure. ||2||
This is the most exalted deed.
Of all faiths, this is the most sublime and excellent faith.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be saved.
You shall be rid of the burden of countless incarnations. ||3||
Your hopes shall be fulfilled,
and the noose of the Messenger of Death will be cut away.
So listen to the Guru's Teachings.
O Nanak, you shall be absorbed in celestial peace. ||4||30||41||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Abandon all your clever tricks.
Become His servant, and serve Him.
Totally erase your self-conceit.
You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||
Be awake and aware with your Guru.

895.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
895.e: Your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain all treasures from the Guru. ||1||Pause||
Let no one think that God and Guru are separate.
The True Guru is the Immaculate Lord.

895.g: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
895.e: Do not believe that He is a mere human being;
He gives honor to the dishonored. ||2||
Hold tight to the Support of the Guru, the Lord.
Give up all other hopes.
Ask for the treasure of the Name of the Lord,
and then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Chant the Mantra of the Guru's Word.
This is the essence of true devotional worship.
When the True Guru becomes merciful,
slave Nanak is enraptured. ||4||28||39||
Chaupaee
In the city of Lahore, there lived a goldsmith,

895.g: ਅਤਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਗ ਕਹੈ ॥
895.e: Whom people used to know as a big swindler.

895.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
895.e: When the Shah’s wife heard about him,
She called him to get the ornaments made.(1)
Dohira

895.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਯੋ; ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਬਚਨ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥
895.e: Then the Raja, acquiescing to the exposition of Shiva, acted the same way.

895.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੋ ਕਾਢ ਹੈ; ਨਾਕ ਲਗਾਯੋ ਆਨਿ ॥੧੨॥
895.e: He took nose out of his mouth and fixed it back on her face.(12)(1)

895.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਉਨਹਤਰੌ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬੯॥੧੨੩੪॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
895.e: Sixty-nine Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (69) (1232)
Chaupaee
As soon as the goldsmith tried to steal, the woman came to know of it.

895.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਧਨ ਮਮ ਹਰ ਨਹਿ ਲੇਈ ॥੩॥
895.e: She would not let him play trick and he could not rob her wealth.(3)
Dohira

895.g: ਕੋਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਸਠ ਕਰ ਰਹਿਯੋ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
895.e: When he had tried thousands of times but had not succeeded,

895.g: ਆਪਨ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ਲੈ; ਰੋਦਨੁ ਕਿਯੋ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੪॥
895.e: Then, remembering his son’s name, he pretended to cry. ( 4)
“Go, take out immediately and put it on the face of the woman.”(11)
Dohira

895.g: ਪੂਤਨ ਸੋ ਪਤ ਪਾਈਯੈ; ਪੂਤ ਭਿਰਤ ਰਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
895.e: ‘We receive the honours through our sons, who fight for our integrity.’

895.g: ਇਹ ਮਿਸ ਰਾਖਿ ਉਡਾਇ ਕੈ; ਲਈ ਸਲਾਕ ਛਪਾਇ ॥੯॥
895.e: And she blew the dust in his eyes and, then, hid away his blow pipe.
Dohira
They are the Support of the breath of life of the Saints.
God is infinite, the highest of the high. ||3||

895.g: ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
895.e: That mind is excellent and sublime, which meditates in remembrance on the Lord.
In His Mercy, the Lord Himself bestows it.
Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are found in the Lord's Name.
Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name. ||4||27||38||
Chaupaee
‘My son named Bandon has died and God has revoked all his bliss.’

895.g: ਜੋ ਕਹਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰ ਮਾਰਿਯੋ ॥

895.e: Saying so, he hit his head on the ground and, being in agony, wailed aloud.(5)
‘He had only one son and that died too,’ thinking this, Chattar started to cry as well.
Instantly, he took advantage and, in the blow pipe, he stole the gold.(6)
He threw hot pipe on the ground and amalgamated gold with the dust,

895.g: ਕਹਿਯੋ ਨ ਸੁਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਯੋ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥

895.e: And said, ‘There was no body left in my house, who could look after my ashes.’(7)

895.g: ਜਬ ਸੁਨਾਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥

895.e: When the woman ascertained goldsmith’s secret, she picked up a handful of dust and blew on his head saying,

895.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੮॥
895.e: ‘Listen, Goldsmith, this dust is over your head, because you have no son in your house.(8)
Chaupaee
She said to him, ‘My husband has gone abroad.

895.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਔਸੀ ਕੋ ਡਾਰੋ ॥

895.e: ‘By drawing lines in the soil, I was guessing, when would my consort come.’(10)
Dohira

895.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੀ; ਜੈਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨਾਰ ॥
895.e: The name of the Shah’s wife was Chattar Prabha and the name of the goldsmith was Jaimal.

895.g: ਘਾਟ ਘੜਤ ਭਯੋ ਸ੍ਵਰਨ ਕੋ; ਤਵਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
895.e: To make the ornaments he came to her house.(2)

896.e: Chaupaee

896.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਪੁਰ ਤਰੈ ਨਦੀ ਇਕ ਬਹੈ ॥

896.e: In the country of the Raja, a rivulet flowed which was known as Chandra Bhagga.
On its banks, he had built a palace, which looked as if Wish karam a (the god of engineering) had built himself.(3)
Chaupaee
As no turbans were available to buy, we thought of a plan,
‘Whosoever you find urinating there, snatch his turban away.’(6)
When the policemen heard thus, they all agreed upon the scheme.
Any apostate who came on pilgrimage, he was sent back without the turban.(7)
Dohira

896.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਏਕ ਪਹਾਰ ਕੋ; ਚਿਤ੍ਰਨਾਥ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮ ॥
896.e: In the hill, there used to live a Raja whose name was Chiter Nath.

896.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਨ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ; ਜਪਤ ਆਠਹੂੰ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
896.e: All the people of the land revered him, all the time.(1)

896.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖੀ ਰਾਨੀ ਰਹੈ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
896.e: His Rani, Indra Mukhi, was wondrously pretty.

896.g: ਸਚੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਕ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਪੁਰਹੂਤ ॥੨॥
896.e: She was as beautiful as Sachi (the consort of god Indra),(2)
Chaupaee
While hunting, we had killed many deer and boars,

896.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਠਾ ਕੌ ਹਮ ਮਗੁ ਲੀਨੌ ॥

896.e: Then we had taken the road to that place and paid obeisance to that pilgritn entity.(3)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
In your mind, meditate on the Lord God.
This is the Teaching given by the Perfect Guru.
All fears and terrors are taken away,
and your hopes shall be fulfilled. ||1||
Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful and rewarding.

896.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
896.e: His value cannot be described; the True Lord is unseen and mysterious. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
Meditate on Him forever, O my mind,
And continually serve Him.
You shall be blessed with truth, intuition and peace, O my friend. ||2||
My Lord and Master is so very great.
In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.
There is no other than Him.
He is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. ||3||
Please take pity on me, and hear my prayer,
that Your servant may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
Nanak chants the Chant of the Lord,

896.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੪੩॥
896.e: whose glory and radiance are the highest of all. ||4||32||43||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the bountiful Lord.
The merciful Lord cherishes all.
The Lord is unseen and infinite.
God is great and endless. ||1||
Dohira

896.g: ਗਹਿਰੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਲ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾ ਸਮ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਆਨ ॥
896.e: Its water was very deep and there was no other rivulet like this.

896.g: ਡਰਤ ਤੈਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਲਾਗਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੪॥
896.e: Dreaded, none dared to swim across, as it looked like a sea.(4)

896.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਏਕ ਗੁਜਰਾਤ ਕੋ; ਘੋਰਾ ਬੇਚਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
896.e: There was one Shah of Gujarat who dealt in horses.

896.g: ਚਲਿ ਆਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਠਾ, ਜਹਾ; ਚਿਤ੍ਰਨਾਥ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ॥੫॥
896.e: He travelled over and came to the place of Chiter Nath.(5)

896.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪਮ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੋ; ਜੌਨ ਲਖੈ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
896.e: Looking at the handsome Shah, the woman forgot her own glamour.

896.g: ਧਨ ਆਪਨ ਕੀ ਕ︀ਯਾ ਚਲੀ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਡਾਰਹਿ ਵਾਰ ॥੬॥
896.e: (She felt) as if, not only her wealth, but also she lost the urge of her youthful desires.(6)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Reliance on mortal man is useless.
O God, my Lord and Master, You are my only Support.
I have discarded all other hopes.

897.e: Then Rani felt relieved and she thanked that the secret was not out.(180)(1)

897.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਬਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੨॥੧੨੭੬॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
897.e: Seventy-second Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (72)(1274)

898.e: Chaupaee

898.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਹੀ ਸੁ ਬਨਿਕਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
ਕਛੂ ਸੰਕ ਚਿਤ ਬੀਚ ਨ ਆਨੀ ॥
898.e: The Shah acted the way he was asked, he did not get any doubt in his mind,
Brought lot of gold-coins and handed over to that swindler.(6)
Chaupaee
He adorned four tier clothes and posed himself as an aristocrat (and he announced),
‘The Raja has granted me an honour and (the territory of) Palwal is my protectorate.(2)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
The tiger leads the cow to the pasture,
the shell is worth thousands of dollars,
and the elephant nurses the goat,
when God bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||
You are the treasure of mercy, O my Beloved Lord God.

898.g: ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
898.e: I cannot even describe Your many Glorious Virtues. ||1||Pause||
The cat sees the meat, but does not eat it,
and the great butcher throws away his knife;
the Creator Lord God abides in the heart;
the net holding the fish breaks apart. ||2||
The dry wood blossoms forth in greenery and red flowers;
in the high desert, the beautiful lotus flower blooms.
The Divine True Guru puts out the fire.
He links His servant to His service. ||3||
He saves even the ungrateful;
my God is forever merciful.
He is forever the helper and support of the humble Saints.
Nanak has found the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||39||50||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
Dohira

898.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਉਪਚਾਰੁ ਕੋ; ਕੀਜੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
898.e: ‘That is why I am going to undertake some welfare work,

898.g: ਤਹਾ ਚਲਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭ; ਲੀਜੈ ਮੋਲ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
898.e: ‘And to perform the task, I will have to act in good manners.’
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
What supports you in this world?
You ignorant fool, who is your companion?

898.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
898.e: The Lord is your only companion; no one knows His condition.

898.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ; ਸੇ ਮੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥
898.e: You look upon the five thieves as your friends. ||1||

898.g: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
898.e: Serve that home, which will save you, my friend.

898.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਵੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
898.e: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love Him in your mind. ||1||Pause||
This human life is passing away in egotism and conflict.
You are not satisfied; such is the flavor of sin.
Wandering and roaming around, you suffer terrible pain.
You cannot cross over the impassable sea of Maya. ||2||

898.g: ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
898.e: You do the deeds which do not help you at all.
As you plant, so shall you harvest.
There is none other than the Lord to save you.
You will be saved, only if God grants His Grace. ||3||
Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.
Please bless Your slave with that gift.

898.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
898.e: Please grant Your Grace, God, and emancipate me.
Nanak has grasped Your Sanctuary, God. ||4||37||48||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
I have found peace in this world.
I will not have to appear before the Righteous Judge of Dharma to give my account.
I will be respected in the Court of the Lord,
and I will not have to enter the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||1||
Now, I know the value of friendship with the Saints.

898.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
898.e: In His Mercy, the Lord has blessed me with His Name. My pre-ordained destiny has been fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
My consciousness is attached to the Guru's feet.
Blessed, blessed is this fortunate time of union.

898.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
898.e: I have applied the dust of the Saints' feet to my forehead,
and all my sins and pains have been eradicated. ||2||
Performing true service to the Holy,
the mortal's mind is purified.
I have seen the fruitful vision of the Lord's humble slave.

898.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
898.e: God's Name dwells within each and every heart. ||3||
All my troubles and sufferings have been taken away;

898.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
898.e: I have merged into the One, from whom I originated.
The Lord of the Universe, incomparably beautiful, has become merciful.
O Nanak, God is perfect and forgiving. ||4||38||49||
Chaupaee
Dohira

898.g: ਆਪੁ ਜੂਤਿਯਨ ਜੁਰਿ ਗਈ; ਰਹੀ ਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ॥
898.e: She got involved in hitting with the slipper and he lost his senses too.

898.g: ਐਸੋ ਚਰਿਤ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ; ਬਾਕੋ ਦਯੋ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
898.e: With such duplicity, she enabled the lover to escape.(5)

898.g: ਅਤਿ ਚਿਤ ਕੋਪ ਬਢਾਇ ਕੈ; ਤਪਤ ਤਾਬ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਨੈਨ ॥
898.e: By making the face look furious,

898.g: ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਨੋ; ਕਹੈ ਬਨਕਿ ਸੋ ਬੈਨ ॥੬॥
898.e: And with eyes wildly open, she said to the Shah (6)
Dohira

898.g: ਔਰ ਖਜਾਨੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੋ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਲਯੋ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
898.e: Whole of the treasurer of the Shah was brought in,

898.g: ਜਾਇ ਜਹਾਨਾਬਾਦ ਮੈ; ਦੈਹੌ ਧਨ ਪਹੁਚਾਇ ॥੭॥
898.e: (And he told him) that he will hand over all that in Jehanbad (Capital of the Emperor).
Chaupaee
He called all the people of the village and to entertain them he spent about one hundred rupees.
He asked them to get ready and arrange some money.
Dohira

898.g: ਬਨਿਯੈ ਜੂਤੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਸੀਖ ਲਈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
898.e: The Shah learnt the lesson after getting beating with slippers,

898.g: ਕਹ ਸ︀ਯਾਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗਯੋ ਭੇਦ ਪਛਾਨ︀ਯੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
898.e: And without discerning the trickery, he went away from the house.(8)(1)

898.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਤਿਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੩॥੧੨੮੪॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
898.e: Seventy-third Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (73)(1282)

898.g: ਜਬ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਪਤਿ ਆਵਤ ਲਖਿ ਪਾਇਸ ॥

898.e: When the woman saw her husband coming towards her, she thought of a deception.
She hit him with a slipper for hundred times and asked why had he come leaving the Pathan.(4)
Dohira

898.g: ਰੋਕ ਰੁਪੈਯਨ ਖਰਚਿ ਕੈ; ਲੀਜੈ ਮੁਹਰ ਬਟਾਇ ॥
898.e: He had intended to collect the rupees and then convert them into goldcoins,

898.g: ਭਰ ਬਰਦਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਘਨੋ; ਖਰਚਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
898.e: So that the high expenses could be met.(5)
Dohira

898.g: ਚੋਰ ਏਕ ਚਤੁਰੋ ਰਹੈ; ਬੈਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਵ ॥
898.e: There was a thief whose name was Bairam.

898.g: ਜਾਤ ਸੇਖਜਾਦੋ ਰਹੈ; ਬਸੈ ਕਾਲਪੀ ਗਾਵ ॥੧॥
898.e: By caste he was a sheikh and used to live in the village of Kaalpi.( 1)
Kabit

898.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲੋਨ ਖੈਯੈ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਛੋਰਿ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜੈਯੈ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲੋਨ ਖੈਯੈ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਗੇ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਜੂਝਿਯੈ ॥
898.e: ‘Who-so-ever’s salt you eat, never abandon him, ‘Who-so-ever’s salt you eat, you should, even, sacrifice your life. ‘Who-so-ever’s salt you eat, never cheat him.

898.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲੋਨ ਖੈਯੈ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਗਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਦੈਯੈ; ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੈਯੈ, ਤਾ ਸੌ ਸਾਚਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਲੂਝਿਯੈ ॥
898.e: ‘Listen to this truth I am stressing, you better, even, die for him. ‘Never commit theft, and if the master gives, it should be equally distributed. .

898.g: ਚੋਰੀ ਨ ਕਮੈਯੈ, ਆਪੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਬਾਟਿ ਖੈਯੈ; ਝੂਠ ਨ ਬਨੈਯੈ, ਕਛੂ ਲੈਬੇ ਕੌ ਨ ਰੂਝਿਯੈ ॥
898.e: ‘Never tell lies, and to achieve something, one should not become greedy.

898.g: ਰੋਸ ਨ ਬਢੈਯੈ, ਬੁਰੀ ਭਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੈਯੈ; ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਮੈਯੈ, ਨਾਥ, ਮੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਬੂਝਿਯੈ ॥੭॥
898.e: Never get angry, even if master rebukes, one should accept. ‘Listen, my beloved, you must perform Your service humbtly.’(7)

899.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

899.g: ਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
899.e: Neither your body nor your mind belong to you.
Attached to Maya, you are entangled in fraud.
You play like a baby lamb.
But suddenly, Death will catch you in its noose. ||1||
Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet, O my mind.

899.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
899.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, which will be your help and support. As Gurmukh, you shall obtain the true wealth. ||1||Pause||
Your unfinished worldly affairs will never be resolved.

899.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਦਿ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
899.e: You shall always regret your sexual desire, anger and pride.
You act in corruption in order to survive,
but not even an iota will go along with you, you ignorant fool! ||2||
You practice deception, and you know many tricks;

899.g: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉ; ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਨੈ ॥
899.e: for the sake of mere shells, you throw dust upon your head.

899.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ; ਤਿਸੈ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
899.e: You never even think of the One who gave you life.
The pain of false greed never leaves you. ||3||
When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,
this mind becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy.
With His lotus hands, He has attached us to the hem of His robe.
Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||4||41||52||
Chaupaee
She was very happy that God has bestowed her with a son,
Chaupaee
He got a monthly salary’s deed written, and, thus, made the Mughal as his debtor.

899.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਿਯੋ ॥

899.e: He rendered his services and, then, stole the pay-role of the cashier.(4)
Dohira

899.g: ਧਾਮ ਜਵਾਈ ਆਪਨੋ ਰਾਖ︀ਯੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
899.e: He assigned himself a name, ghar-jawai, the live-in son-in-law,

899.g: ਬਿਧਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਮੈ; ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
899.e: And came and started to dwell with a widow.(3)
God killed the five tigers.
He has driven out the ten wolves.
The three whirl-pools have stopped spinning.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fear of reincarnation is gone. ||1||
Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I live.

899.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
899.e: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; the True Lord is forever and ever the forgiver. ||1||Pause||
The mountain of sin is burnt down, like straw,

899.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਪੂਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੈਰ ॥
899.e: by chanting and meditating on the Name, and worshipping God's feet.
God, the embodiment of bliss, becomes manifest everywhere.
Linked to His loving devotional worship, I enjoy peace. ||2||
I have crossed over the world-ocean, as if it were no bigger than a calf's footprint on the ground.

899.g: ਖੇਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਨਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
899.e: I shall never again have to endure suffering or grief.
The ocean is contained in the pitcher.
This is not such an amazing thing for the Creator to do. ||3||
When I am separated from Him, then I am consigned to the nether regions.
When He lifts me up and pulls me out, then I am enraptured by His Glance of Grace.
Vice and virtue are not under my control.
With love and affection, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||40||51||
Chaupaee
The Mughal was distressed and disclosed that the debtor had taken away all his wealth.

899.g: ਜੋ ਇਹ ਬੈਨਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥

899.e: Who-so-ever listened, made fun of him considering him a liar (and told him).(6)

899.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਜੁ ਲੈ ਖਾਯੋ ॥

899.e: ‘If you had borrowed money from some one, how could he steal from you?

899.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ, ਜੋ ਹੈ ਲੈ ਗਯੋ ॥੭॥
899.e: ‘Why had you taken loan from him? What, then, if he has taken your horses in lieu (of his money).’
Dohira

899.g: ਦਿਨ ਕੋ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਲ︀ਯੋ ਕਰਜਾਈ ਕਹਲਾਇ ॥
899.e: (Now, as the Mughal was left with no money and could not pay his wages) He declared that he (Mughal) was his debtor.

899.g: ਸਕਲ ਲੋਕ ਠਟਕੇ ਰਹੈ; ਰੈਨਾਈ ਲਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
899.e: He put the people into astonishment, took the horse and went away.(5)
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
I seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord.

899.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
899.e: I have become fearless, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my pains have been taken away. ||1||Pause||

899.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
899.e: That person, within whose mind the Lord abides,
does not see the impassible world-ocean.
All one's affairs are resolved,

899.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
899.e: by chanting continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

899.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਹਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
899.e: Why should His slave feel any anxiety?
The Guru places His hand upon my forehead.
The fear of birth and death is dispelled;
I am a sacrifice to the Perfect Guru. ||2||
I am enraptured, meeting with the Guru, the Transcendent Lord.

899.g: ਸੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
899.e: He alone obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, who is blessed by His Mercy.
One who is blessed by the Grace of the Supreme Lord God,
crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Holy people.
Your face shall be radiant and bright in the Court of the Lord.
Celebrate and be blissful, and abandon all corruption.
O Nanak, meditate on the Lord and cross over. ||4||42||53||

899.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਧਨੁ ਇਕਠੋ ਕੈ ਲਯੋ ॥
899.e: When the Shah had gone to sleep, he accumulated all the wealth,
He told his accomplice to watch at the gate and not to awake him.(8)
Dohira

899.g: ਵਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਿਯੋ; ਭੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
899.e: Every body called him a liar without understanding the secret.

899.g: ਵਹ ਦਿਨ ਧਨ ਹੈ ਹਰ ਗਯੋ; ਰਾਮ ਕਰੈ, ਸੋ ਹਇ ॥੮॥
899.e: Each day is auspicious and it happens the way Lord God wills.(8)(1)

899.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਪਚਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੫॥੧੩੦੨॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
899.e: Seventy-fifth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction.(75)(1299)
Dohira

899.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਸੁਨਿਯੈ ਕਥਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
899.e: Then the Minister said, ‘Listen to another story, my Raja.’

899.g: ਤੇਹੀ ਚੋਰ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਕ; ਕਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਕਹੋ ਉਤਾਲ ॥੧॥
899.e: ‘The same thief played another trick which I tell you now.(1)
Chaupaee

899.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਯੌ ਆਯੋ ॥
899.e: When he had stolen the wealth, another thought came into his mind,

899.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪੈਯੈ ॥੨॥
899.e: ‘Why not play one more trick through which a pretty woman could be possessed.’(2)
Dohira

899.g: ਛੋਰਿ ਦ੍ਵਾਰੋ ਪਾਛਲੋ; ਭਾਜ ਗਏ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥
899.e: Leaving his companion at the doorstep, he quickly ran away.

899.g: ਸਭ ਰੁਪਯਨ ਹਰ ਲੈ ਗਏ; ਬਨਿਯਾ ਭਏ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥੯॥
899.e: He swindled all the rupees and the Shah was very much distressed.(9)(1)

899.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ︀ਯਾਨੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਚੌਹਤਰੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭੪॥੧੨੯੩॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
899.e: Seventy-fourth Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed with Benediction. (74)(1291)
Dohira

899.g: ਮੁਗਲ ਏਕ ਗਜਨੀ ਰਹੈ; ਬਖਤਿਯਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮ ॥
899.e: A Mughal used to live in Ghazni and his name was Mukhtiyar.

899.g: ਬਡੇ ਸਦਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਨੇ; ਬਹੁਤ ਗਾਠਿ ਮੈ ਦਾਮ ॥੧॥
899.e: He had palatial houses and possessed lot of wealth.(1)

899.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਇਕ ਹਯ ਹੁਤੋ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਚੋਰ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
899.e: He had a horse, which a thief came to observe.

899.g: ਯਾ ਕੋ ਕ︀ਯੋ ਹੂੰ ਚੋਰਿਯੈ ਕਛੂ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
899.e: He (the thief) contemplated how to steal that?(2)

899.g: ਆਨਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕੀ ਕਰੀ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਤਲਾਸ ॥
899.e: He came and asked for a job in the Mughal’s house.

899.g: ਮੁਗਲ ਮਹੀਨਾ ਕੈ ਤੁਰਤ; ਚਾਕਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾਸ ॥੩॥
899.e: The Mughal immediately engaged him on monthly terms.(3)
